frontmatter.summary: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can

entries.body:
When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

**Prerequisite:** None  
**Minimum level:** 3

entries.title: Subtle Spell
entries.summary: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without

frontmatter.title: Subtle Spell
frontmatter.summary: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without

entries.body:
When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without any somatic or verbal components.

**Prerequisite:** None  
**Minimum level:** 3

entries.title: Armor of the Ascetic
entries.summary: You exude an aura of peace

frontmatter.title: Armor of the Ascetic
frontmatter.summary: You exude an aura of peace

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 13th-level Monk

You exude an aura of peace. When you finish a short or long rest, you gain the benefits of the sanctuary spell, which last until the end of your next rest, or until you break the spell.

entries.title: Arresting Strike (Monk Technique)
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Arresting Strike (Monk Technique)
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 1 Ki to stunt its mobility and force it to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, its speed is reduced to zero until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.title: Ascetic Fortitude
entries.summary: You can fortify your physical form with your Ki

frontmatter.title: Ascetic Fortitude
frontmatter.summary: You can fortify your physical form with your Ki

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 9th-level Monk

You can fortify your physical form with your Ki. When you take damage from a source you can see, you can use your reaction to expend 2 Ki and reduce that instance of damage by two Martial Arts Dice + your Wisdom modifier.

entries.title: Aura Sight
entries.summary: You have awakened the spiritual potential of your senses

frontmatter.title: Aura Sight
frontmatter.summary: You have awakened the spiritual potential of your senses

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 9th-level Monk

You have awakened the spiritual potential of your senses. You gain Blindsight out to a 20-foot radius. Within this radius, you know the exact location of creatures and objects, even if they are invisible, unless they are behind total cover.

At 13th level your Blindsight radius increases to 30 feet, and finally, at 18th level its radius increases to 60 feet.

entries.title: Banishing Strike (Monk Technique)
entries.summary: "Prerequisites: 13th-level Monk Once per turn when you hit a creature

frontmatter.title: Banishing Strike (Monk Technique)
frontmatter.summary: "Prerequisites: 13th-level Monk Once per turn when you hit a creature

entries.body:
Prerequisites: 13th-level Monk Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 3 Ki to empower your blow with legendary force, forcing it to make a Charisma saving throw. It takes bonus force damage equal to three Martial Arts Dice on a failure, and half as much on a success.

Should this attack reduce the target to 50 hit points or less, it is shunted to a harmless demiplane and is Incapacitated. It then reappears in the unoccupied space nearest to the space it last occupied at the end of your next turn.

entries.title: Befuddling Strike
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Befuddling Strike
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 9th-level Monk

Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 1 Ki to assault its nervous system, forcing it to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it is Incapacitated until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.title: Burning Blade
entries.summary: As a bonus action, you can spend 1 Ki to infuse one melee Martial Arts

frontmatter.title: Burning Blade
frontmatter.summary: As a bonus action, you can spend 1 Ki to infuse one melee Martial Arts

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

As a bonus action, you can spend 1 Ki to infuse one melee Martial Arts weapon you are holding with burning Ki. For the next minute, the weapon emits bright light in a 30-foot radius and attacks with it deal fire damage so long as you hold it.

entries.title: Commune with Self
entries.summary: You have gained the ability to contact the Ki of your previous lives to

frontmatter.title: Commune with Self
frontmatter.summary: You have gained the ability to contact the Ki of your previous lives to

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 9th-level Monk

You have gained the ability to contact the Ki of your previous lives to gain information. As an action, you can spend 5 Ki to enter a meditative state for the next 10 minutes, and consult your previous lives. If this meditation is not interrupted, you gain information as if you had cast the commune spell.

entries.title: Conjure Previous Life
entries.summary: You summon a specter of your past life to come to your aid

frontmatter.title: Conjure Previous Life
frontmatter.summary: You summon a specter of your past life to come to your aid

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 13th-level Monk

You summon a specter of your past life to come to your aid. As an action, you can spend 5 Ki to produce the effects of the summon celestial TCE spell at 5th-level using your body as a Spellcasting focus, without requiring the normal material components. The spell has the following changes:

Appearance & Statistics. You must choose the Defender option, and it takes on the appearance of a Humanoid Monk of Medium size, though it may not be the same race as you.

Ki Infusion. When conjured, you can infuse the Celestial with any amount of your Ki, expending it. The Celestial can then use this Ki to use any Mystic Technique you know, but it cannot use conjure previous life again.

Radiant Strikes. Its radiant mace attacks are replaced by unarmed strikes that use your Martial Arts Die for damage.

entries.title: Crippling Strike (Monk Technique)
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Crippling Strike (Monk Technique)
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 1 Ki to cripple its senses and force it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, you choose if it is Blinded, Deafened, or unable to speak until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.title: Crushing Strike
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a target with an unarmed strike, you can

frontmatter.title: Crushing Strike
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a target with an unarmed strike, you can

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

Once per turn when you hit a target with an unarmed strike, you can spend Ki (up to your Wisdom modifier) to empower it with deadly force. For each Ki you spend, the attack deals additional damage equal to your Martial Arts Die.

entries.title: Dazing Strike
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Dazing Strike
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can expend 1 Ki to strike its head, forcing it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must subtract 1d4 from the first ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.

entries.title: Deflect Missile
entries.summary: "When you are hit by a ranged weapon attack you can see, you can use a

frontmatter.title: Deflect Missile
frontmatter.summary: "When you are hit by a ranged weapon attack you can see, you can use a

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

When you are hit by a ranged weapon attack you can see, you can use a reaction to reduce the damage by your Monk level + your Martial Arts Die + your Dexterity modifier. If you reduce the damage to zero, you catch the projectile in a free hand.

If you catch it, you can spend 1 Ki to immediately make a ranged (20/60) Martial Arts attack with the projectile as part of the same reaction. You are proficient with this attack.

At 11th level, you can expend 1 Ki to use this Technique on any ranged attack, including ranged spell attacks.

entries.title: Deflect Strike
entries.summary: When you are hit by a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 Ki as a

frontmatter.title: Deflect Strike
frontmatter.summary: When you are hit by a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 Ki as a

entries.body:
When you are hit by a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 Ki as a reaction and reduce the damage by your Monk level + your Martial Arts Die + your Dexterity modifier. If you reduce the damage to zero, you can make an unarmed strike against your attacker as part of the same reaction.

At 11th level, you can use this Technique against any melee attack, including melee spell attacks.

entries.title: Divine Light
entries.summary: You learn two Cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list

frontmatter.title: Divine Light
frontmatter.summary: You learn two Cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list

entries.body: You learn two Cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list. Wisdom is your Spellcasting modifier for these spells, and you use your body as the Spellcasting focus for them.

entries.title: Empowered Strike
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Empowered Strike
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body:
Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 1 Ki to strike with great power and force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is knocked back horizontally from you in a line a number of feet equal to 5 times your Wisdom modifier, then falls Prone.

Creatures that are at least one size larger than you have advantage on this Strength saving throw.

entries.title: Empty Body
entries.summary: You can become a being of pure spirit, if only temporarily

frontmatter.title: Empty Body
frontmatter.summary: You can become a being of pure spirit, if only temporarily

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 18th-level Monk

You can become a being of pure spirit, if only temporarily. As a bonus action, you can expend 4 Ki to become invisible for 1 minute. For the duration, you are resistant to all damage but force damage. You can end this effect with a bonus action.

You can also spend 8 Ki to cast the astral projection spell without the normal material components. However, you can only target yourself and cannot take other creatures with you.

entries.title: Enhanced Grip
entries.summary: Each time a creature starts its turn Grappled by you it takes

frontmatter.title: Enhanced Grip
frontmatter.summary: Each time a creature starts its turn Grappled by you it takes

entries.body: Each time a creature starts its turn Grappled by you it takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Martial Arts Die. You can also drag Grappled creatures up to your full speed.

entries.title: Envenomed Strike
entries.summary: "Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts

frontmatter.title: Envenomed Strike
frontmatter.summary: "Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 1 Ki to deal bonus poison damage equal to your Martial Arts Die and force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is Poisoned until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.title: Friend of Beast & Leaf
entries.summary: Your Ki can read the energies of the natural world

frontmatter.title: Friend of Beast & Leaf
frontmatter.summary: Your Ki can read the energies of the natural world

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 9th-level Monk

Your Ki can read the energies of the natural world. As an action, you can spend 5 Ki to enter a meditative state for the next 10 minutes. If the meditation is not interrupted, you gain information as if you had cast commune with nature.

entries.title: Gale Rush
entries.summary: As an action, you spend Ki (up to your Wisdom modifier) and focus it

frontmatter.title: Gale Rush
frontmatter.summary: As an action, you spend Ki (up to your Wisdom modifier) and focus it

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

As an action, you spend Ki (up to your Wisdom modifier) and focus it into your palm. For each Ki spent, you move up to 10 feet in a straight line and force one target at the end of this movement to make a Dexterity saving throw.

On a failure, it takes thunder damage equal to one Martial Arts Die per Ki spent and is knocked Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and does not fall Prone.

entries.title: Gentling Touch
entries.summary: Once per turn in place of an attack, you can expend 1 Ki to touch a

frontmatter.title: Gentling Touch
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn in place of an attack, you can expend 1 Ki to touch a

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

Once per turn in place of an attack, you can expend 1 Ki to touch a creature and manipulate its Ki to put it to sleep. Roll five Martial Arts Dice. If the target's remaining hit points are less than or equal to the total roll, it falls Unconscious for 10 minutes. The creature wakes up if another creature uses its action to wake it, or if it takes any damage.

You can expend additional Ki (up to your Wisdom modifier) to empower this Technique, rolling an additional Martial Arts Die and adding it to the total for each additional Ki spent.

entries.title: Heavenly Step
entries.summary: While using your Unarmored Movement, you can move along vertical

frontmatter.title: Heavenly Step
frontmatter.summary: While using your Unarmored Movement, you can move along vertical

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 9th-level Monk

While using your Unarmored Movement, you can move along vertical surfaces, across liquids, and upside down on ceilings without falling during the move.

If you stop on one of these surfaces, you can spend 1 Ki to remain in place until the start of your next turn.

entries.title: Impairing Strike
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Impairing Strike
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 1 Ki to strategically cripple its Ki flow, forcing it to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, choose one of the target's ability scores.

Until the start of your next turn, it has disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws with that ability score, and attacks or spells cast with it deal half damage.

entries.title: Improvised Strikes
entries.summary: You are adept at fighting with whatever is at hand

frontmatter.title: Improvised Strikes
frontmatter.summary: You are adept at fighting with whatever is at hand

entries.body: You are adept at fighting with whatever is at hand. You gain proficiency with improvised weapons, and your attacks with improvised weapons count as Martial Arts attacks.

entries.title: Monk Techniques
entries.summary: Mystic Techniques available to the Monk

frontmatter.title: Monk Techniques
frontmatter.summary: Mystic Techniques available to the Monk

entries.body:
# Monk Techniques

Monks learn Mystic Techniques at 2nd level. Techniques can be replaced when gaining a Monk level, and their prerequisites must be met. Signature Techniques granted by a Monastic Tradition do not count against the number known and cannot be replaced.

## Mystic Techniques

![[monk-techniques.base]]

[[character-options/classes/Monk|Back to the Monk class]]

entries.title: Indomitable Spirit
entries.summary: You can augment your physical abilities with spiritual power

frontmatter.title: Indomitable Spirit
frontmatter.summary: You can augment your physical abilities with spiritual power

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 9th-level Monk

You can augment your physical abilities with spiritual power. Whenever you make an Athletics check, you can expend 1 Ki to add your Wisdom modifier to your roll. You can do so after you roll, but before you know if your roll succeeds or fails.

entries.title: Mantle of Courtesy
entries.summary: Spiritual insight guides your speech

frontmatter.title: Mantle of Courtesy
frontmatter.summary: Spiritual insight guides your speech

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 9th-level Monk

Spiritual insight guides your speech. You gain proficiency in Persuasion, and you can use Wisdom, in place of Charisma for any Persuasion checks you make.

After you make a Persuasion check, you can expend 1 Ki to replace your d20 roll with your Monk level.

entries.title: Mystic Regeneration
entries.summary: You can draw on your Ki to stimulate natural healing

frontmatter.title: Mystic Regeneration
frontmatter.summary: You can draw on your Ki to stimulate natural healing

entries.body: You can draw on your Ki to stimulate natural healing. As an action, you can spend 2 Ki to regain hit points equal to your Martial Arts Die + your Wisdom modifier.

entries.title: Mystical Integrity
entries.summary: Your sense of self and strength of your will are unshakable

frontmatter.title: Mystical Integrity
frontmatter.summary: Your sense of self and strength of your will are unshakable

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 13th-level Monk

Your sense of self and strength of your will are unshakable. You are immune to any spell or effect that would alter your form or teleport you, unless you wish to be affected.

entries.title: Patient Defense
entries.summary: You quiet your spirit, entering a defensive stance to better defend

frontmatter.title: Patient Defense
frontmatter.summary: You quiet your spirit, entering a defensive stance to better defend

entries.body: You quiet your spirit, entering a defensive stance to better defend against incoming blows. You can spend 1 Ki to take the Dodge action as a bonus action on your turn.

entries.title: Probing Strike
entries.summary: "Whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 Ki

frontmatter.title: Probing Strike
frontmatter.summary: "Whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 Ki

entries.body:
Whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 Ki to learn one characteristic from the following list:

Armor Class

Highest Ability Score

Condition Immunities

Lowest Ability Score

Damage Resistances

& Immunities

One Special Feature

(Spellcasting, Exploits, etc.)

entries.title: Quivering Palm
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Quivering Palm
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 18th-level Monk

Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 5 Ki to infuse its spirit with deadly vibrations, which persist for a number of days equal to your Monk level. If you and this creature are on the same plane of existence, you can use your action to end the vibrations and force it to make a Constitution saving throw. It is reduced to 0 hit points on a failure, and takes necrotic damage equal to eight Martial Arts Dice on a success.

You can only have one creature under the mystical effects of this Technique at a time. Using this Technique on another creature harmlessly ends the effect on previous creatures.

Master even more Techniques! Want to master even more mystical or supernatural Techniques for your Monk? Make sure to check out the Alternate Monk: Expanded, a free supplement for the Alternate Monk that includes a multitude of additional Mystic Techniques for your Monk and nine more Monastic Traditions to choose from!

entries.title: Seeking Strike
entries.summary: Your spirit can guide your strikes if your body fails

frontmatter.title: Seeking Strike
frontmatter.summary: Your spirit can guide your strikes if your body fails

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

Your spirit can guide your strikes if your body fails. Whenever you miss with a Martial Arts attack, you can spend 1 Ki to roll your attack again, but you must use the new result.

This Technique does not count against the normal limit of one Ki feature or Technique per attack.

entries.title: Severing Strike
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Severing Strike
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 13th-level Monk

Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 3 Ki to break its connection to the arcane, forcing it to make a saving throw with its Spellcasting ability. On a failure, it cannot cast or concentrate on spells for 1 minute. It can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

Awaken the Third Eye **Prerequisite:** 18th-level Monk As an action, you can expend 8 Ki to enter a meditative state for 1 minute, granting you the benefits of the foresight spell.

While this effect is active, your Ki maximum is reduced by 8. You can end this effect early as an action on your turn.

Word of Creation **Prerequisite:** 18th-level Monk You can draw on your intimate knowledge of the Ki that flows through all to pluck the threads of creation. As an action, you can spend 7 Ki to produce the effects of the divine word spell, using Wisdom as your Spellcasting modifier.

Once you use your Ki to cast divine word, you must finish a short or long rest before you can cast it in this way again.

entries.title: Slow Fall
entries.summary: You move through the air as light as a feather

frontmatter.title: Slow Fall
frontmatter.summary: You move through the air as light as a feather

entries.body: You move through the air as light as a feather. You reduce any falling damage you take by five times your Monk level, so long as you are not Grapled, Incapacitated, or Restrained.

entries.title: Slowing Strike
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Slowing Strike
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 1 Ki to assault its Ki flow, forcing it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it suffers the effects of the slow spell until the start of your next turn.

You do not need to concentrate on this effect.

entries.title: Spiritual Armor
entries.summary: You can reinforce your body with spiritual power

frontmatter.title: Spiritual Armor
frontmatter.summary: You can reinforce your body with spiritual power

entries.body:
You can reinforce your body with spiritual power. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 Ki to gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of 1).

When a creature damages these temporary hit points, you can use a reaction to cause the attacker to take force damage equal to your Martial Arts Die.

entries.title: Step of the Wind
entries.summary: You move with the speed of the wind

frontmatter.title: Step of the Wind
frontmatter.summary: You move with the speed of the wind

entries.body: You move with the speed of the wind. You can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action. When you do so, your jump distance is doubled until the end of your current turn.

entries.title: Stunning Strike
entries.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

frontmatter.title: Stunning Strike
frontmatter.summary: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack,

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee Martial Arts attack, you can spend 1 Ki to strike body, mind, and soul, forcing it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is Stunned until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.title: Tongue of Sun & Moon
entries.summary: You can communicate on a spiritual level

frontmatter.title: Tongue of Sun & Moon
frontmatter.summary: You can communicate on a spiritual level

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 13th-level Monk

You can communicate on a spiritual level. When you talk to a creature that speaks at least one language, it hears you speak in its native tongue, and you hear its reply in yours.

If you use this Technique to communicate with a creature that does not speak any language, you can only communicate and understand simple ideas, limited by its Intelligence.

entries.title: Tremor Strike
entries.summary: "Prerequisites: 9th-level Monk As an action, you can spend Ki (up to

frontmatter.title: Tremor Strike
frontmatter.summary: "Prerequisites: 9th-level Monk As an action, you can spend Ki (up to

entries.body:
Prerequisites: 9th-level Monk As an action, you can spend Ki (up to your Wisdom modifier) and strike the ground, destroying an adjacent 25-foot cone of earth along the ground, forcing creatures to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, targets take bludgeoning damage equal to a Martial Arts Die per Ki spent and fall Prone. On a success, they take half damage and do not fall Prone.

Structures in this area take the maximum damage, and the area of this Technique becomes difficult terrain until cleared.

entries.title: Typhoon Strike
entries.summary: As an action, you can spend 1 Ki strike out at every creature near you

frontmatter.title: Typhoon Strike
frontmatter.summary: As an action, you can spend 1 Ki strike out at every creature near you

entries.body: As an action, you can spend 1 Ki strike out at every creature near you. All creatures within reach of an unarmed strike or melee Martial Arts weapon you are wielding must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take damage of your attack's type equal to your Martial Arts Die + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.title: Warrior Adept
entries.summary: You have trained in a specialized style of fighting

frontmatter.title: Warrior Adept
frontmatter.summary: You have trained in a specialized style of fighting

entries.body:
**Prerequisite:** 5th-level Monk

You have trained in a specialized style of fighting. You gain a Fighting Style of your choice from the list below. As a Monk, you can only gain one Fighting Style through this Technique:

## Archery

**Prerequisite:** Dexterity of 13 or higher

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapons, and your attacks with ranged weapons ignore half-cover and treat three-quarters cover as half cover.

### Blind Warrior

**Prerequisite:** proficiency in Perception

You have Blindsight with a range in feet equal to 5 times your Proficiency Bonus. In that range, you can see invisible targets and anything that isn't behind total cover or hidden from you.

### Balanced Fighting

When wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

### Featherweight Fighting

**Prerequisite:** Dexterity of 13, proficiency in Acrobatics

While you are unarmed or wielding only light weapons, and are not wearing medium or heavy armor, your speed increases by 10 feet, and you gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls with light melee weapons and unarmed strikes.

### Hurler

**Prerequisite:** Strength or Dexterity of 11

You can draw one thrown weapon as part of a ranged attack you make with it, and the range of your thrown weapon attacks is doubled.

While wielding only thrown weapons, you can make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon as a bonus action.

### Polearm Fighting

**Prerequisite:** Strength and Dexterity of 11 or higher

You gain a +1 bonus to your damage rolls with glaives, halberds, pikes, quarterstaffs, and spears so long as you are wielding only that weapon and no shield. When doing so, creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter or move within your reach with that weapon.

### Versatile Fighting

**Prerequisite:** Strength or Dexterity of 11 or higher

While wielding a single versatile weapon and no shield, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with that weapon.

While doing so, you can use your bonus action to make one Grapple or Shove, or take the Use an Object action.

entries.title: Eldritch Blade
entries.summary: You focus your Patron's power into a sinister weapon

frontmatter.title: Eldritch Blade
frontmatter.summary: You focus your Patron's power into a sinister weapon

entries.body: You focus your Patron's power into a sinister weapon. As a bonus action, conjure a nonmagical melee weapon of your choice in an empty hand. It can serve as a Trinket for one invocation. You are proficient with it and can use your Pact modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls. Its attacks deal the same damage type as Eldritch Blast but do not apply its other effects. It disappears if it is more than 5 feet from you for 1 minute, if you conjure another blade, dismiss it, or die. You can bond a magic melee weapon in a 1-hour ritual; bonding another ends the previous bond.

entries.title: Eldritch Familiar
entries.summary: You learn find familiar and can cast it as a ritual without it counting against your Spells Known

frontmatter.incomplete_reason: The submitted excerpt lists this option but omits its rules text. Awaiting the complete source entry.
frontmatter.title: Eldritch Familiar
frontmatter.summary: You learn find familiar and can cast it as a ritual without it counting against your Spells Known

entries.body: You learn find familiar and can cast it as a ritual without it counting against your Spells Known. Your familiar can take the forms listed in the Eldritch Familiar catalogue. It shares your initiative, moves and uses reactions independently, and Dodges unless you command it as a bonus action. When you cast a spell or Eldritch Blast, it can originate from your familiar if it is within 60 feet.

entries.title: Eldritch Tome
entries.summary: Your Tome contains your known Warlock spells and grants one additional invocation without prerequisites

frontmatter.incomplete_reason: The submitted excerpt lists this option but omits its rules text. Awaiting the complete source entry.
frontmatter.title: Eldritch Tome
frontmatter.summary: Your Tome contains your known Warlock spells and grants one additional invocation without prerequisites

entries.body: Your Tome contains your known Warlock spells and grants one additional invocation without prerequisites. The Tome is its Trinket. After a long rest you can replace that invocation and one known spell with another of the same level. You can cast ritual-tagged Warlock spells in the Tome as rituals. entries.body:
# Arcana Smite Path

**Damage type:** Force

Arcana reaches and repositions first, then unravels what the foe depends on.

## Using This Path

- **When you can smite.** When you hit with a melee weapon attack or an unarmed strike, expend a spell slot to use one smite from this path. You can use only one smite per hit.
- **Slot scaling.** A smite accepts its listed slot or higher. Each slot level above the listed level adds one damage die, to a maximum of six dice. A 5th-tier smite has fixed damage and accepts only a 5th-level slot.
- **Access.** The table shows the Paladin level and minimum slot for each smite.
- **Saving throws.** Use your spell save DC.
- **Concentration.** A smite marked concentration lasts until your concentration is broken. You can't use it while concentrating on a spell; casting a concentration spell ends the smite. You can concentrate on only one smite at a time. Any smite effect lasting past the end of the target's next turn requires concentration.
- **Limits.** A smite's effect lasts no longer than 1 minute and affects creatures in the fight, not objects or the world.
- **Improved dice.** Each damage die marked `*` increases one size at Paladin 9th level: d6 becomes d8, and d8 becomes d10. This applies to the base damage, added dice from higher-level slots, and the listed maximum.
- **Righteous Strikes.** This path uses force damage for Righteous Strikes.

| Tier | Required slot | Paladin level | Concentration |
| ---- | ------------- | ------------- | ------------- |
| 1    | 1st-level     | 2             | No            |
| 2    | 2nd-level     | 5             | No            |
| 3    | 3rd-level     | 9             | Yes           |
| 4    | 4th-level     | 13            | No            |
| 5    | 5th-level     | 17            | Yes           |

## Smites

### Darting Smite

_1st-tier smite · 1st-level slot · Paladin level 2nd+_

Your weapon is coated in sky-blue arcane energy, and the attack deals an extra 2d8 force damage for a 1st-level slot, plus 1d8 for each slot level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 6d8. Additionally, a dart of magical force strikes a different creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the target. The dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage. A creature protected by the shield spell takes no damage from the dart.

### Phasing Smite

_2nd-tier smite · 2nd-level slot · Paladin level 5th+_

A fine mist surrounds your weapon, and the attack deals an extra 3d6* force damage for a 2nd-level slot, plus 1d6* for each slot level higher than 2nd, to a maximum of 6d6*. You can then teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

### Warding Smite

_3rd-tier smite · 3rd-level slot · Paladin level 9th+ · concentration_

Glowing runes appear around your weapon, and the attack deals an extra 4d10 force damage for a 3rd-level slot, plus 1d10 for each slot level higher than 3rd, to a maximum of 6d10. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it can't impart conditions onto other creatures for up to 1 minute or until your concentration is broken.

### Dispelling Smite

_4th-tier smite · 4th-level slot · Paladin level 13th+_

Arcane energy flows into your weapon, and the attack deals an extra 5d8 force damage for a 4th-level slot, plus 1d8 for each slot level higher than 4th, to a maximum of 6d8. Additionally, any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 12 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

### Expelling Smite

_5th-tier smite · 5th-level slot · Paladin level 17th+ · concentration_

Your weapon crackles with force, and the attack deals an extra 6d12 force damage for a 5th-level slot. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, you teleport it up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within that range, and for up to 1 minute or until your concentration is broken its speed is halved and it can't take reactions. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the speed and reaction effect on a success.

---

entries.title: Paladin Smite Paths
entries.summary: Nine themed paths of escalating Paladin smites

frontmatter.title: Paladin Smite Paths
frontmatter.summary: Nine themed paths of escalating Paladin smites

entries.body:
# Paladin Smite Paths

Divine Smite draws its smites from these paths. Choose one path at 2nd level and a second at 11th. Each path has five smites, one for each spell slot level from 1st through 5th. Each path follows a single through-line: every smite deepens the one before it or opens the next act.

## Using Smites

- **Hit, then spend.** When you hit with a melee weapon attack or an unarmed strike, you can expend a spell slot to use one smite. You can use only one smite per hit.
- **Slot level.** Each smite lists the lowest slot it accepts. A higher slot adds one die for each level above that, to a maximum of six dice. Smites with fixed damage (5th tier) accept only 5th-level slots.
- **Availability.** Smites unlock by tier: 1st-level smites at 2nd level, 2nd-level smites at 5th, 3rd-level smites at 9th, 4th-level smites at 13th, and 5th-level smites at 17th.
- **Saving throws.** The DC equals your spell save DC.
- **Concentration.** A smite marked concentration lasts until your concentration is broken, as if you were concentrating on a spell. You can't use it while concentrating on a spell, casting a concentration spell ends it, and you can concentrate on only one smite at a time. Any effect that would last past the end of the target's next turn requires concentration.
- **Combat scale.** No smite effect lasts longer than 1 minute, and no smite affects objects or the world. Smites act on creatures in the fight.
- **Marked dice.** A die marked with an asterisk grows one size when you reach 9th level (d6 becomes d8, d8 becomes d10).
- **Damage types.** Righteous Strikes uses the damage type of a path you know. For Storm, choose lightning or thunder; see the Paladin class table.

## Choose a Path

Each path has five smites, unlocking as your Paladin level rises. Choose the theme and combat effect you want to build around; the linked page includes that path’s full rules and all five smites.

- **[[Corrosion|Corrosion Smite Path]]** · Acid damage — Strips away a foe's defenses, then corrodes its body.
- **[[Arcana|Arcana Smite Path]]** · Force damage — Repositions enemies and disrupts the magic and protections they rely on.
- **[[Frost|Frost Smite Path]]** · Cold damage — Slows enemies, spreads that control across the field, then locks a target in place.
- **[[Radiance|Radiance Smite Path]]** · Radiant damage — Reveals hidden foes, blinds them, binds them, and brings divine judgment.
- **[[Inferno|Inferno Smite Path]]** · Fire damage — Punishes a foe for attacking or moving, escalating into overwhelming heat.
- **[[Judgment|Judgment Smite Path]]** · Psychic damage — Shakes a foe's courage, footing, aim, and control of its actions.
- **[[Storm|Storm Smite Path]]** · lightning or thunder damage — Opens with thunder and builds into lightning, disruption, and surging force.
- **[[Venom|Venom Smite Path]]** · Poison damage — Undermines a foe's body, steadily weakening its ability to act.
- **[[Blight-Smite-Path|Blight Smite Path]]** · Necrotic damage — Drains a foe's vitality and withers its ability to fight.

## Designer's Notes

> [!info]- Design and playtest notes
>
> - Dice formula. Base die d8. Concentration adds one die size. A non-damage rider subtracts one die size until 9th level, which is what the asterisk marks. At 17th level the top tier adds one die size. A smite that locks down a creature gets no further discount, because no smite locks a creature down.
> - Path rules. Effects stay on combat scale (1 minute or less, creatures only). Each path has one through-line. Riders rise from tier to tier. A failed save never takes a creature's turn: it can hobble, tax, or redirect, but the creature still acts.
> - Playtest summary. A solo level 11 paladin against a homebrew dire owlbear (140 HP, AC 15) and an alpha version (200 HP, three Legendary Resistances) showed smites adding a modest edge, about 3 to 6 points of win rate against the alpha. Bonus-action Lay on Hands drove most of the survivability gap over the base file. The arena also caught Corroding Smite's natural-weapon wording, now fixed.
> - Dials, if play shows overshoot. Keep the rider penalty past 9th level. Drop the 17th-level die step for concentration smites. Raise Rekindle's cost to 4 charges per slot level. Limit Legendary Conviction's refund to 3rd-level and higher slots.
> - Changes from the source files. Renamed: Decaying to Corroding, Ruinous to Dissolving, Missile to Darting, Misty to Phasing, Runic to Warding, Banishing to Expelling, Constricting to Shackling, Firestorm to Scorching, Radiating to Blistering, Wrathful to Cowing, Repentant to Humbling, Thunderous to Thundering. New: Sundering. Replaced: Gripping with Wasting. Retired: Pooling. The nine per-path Strikes lines are gone, because Righteous Strikes now names a damage type for each path. Deathly is the only smite name that isn't a gerund.

---

entries.body:
# Judgment Smite Path

**Damage type:** Psychic

Judgment shakes a foe's nerve, then its footing, then its aim, and finally its sense of what it is doing.

## Using This Path

- **When you can smite.** When you hit with a melee weapon attack or an unarmed strike, expend a spell slot to use one smite from this path. You can use only one smite per hit.
- **Slot scaling.** A smite accepts its listed slot or higher. Each slot level above the listed level adds one damage die, to a maximum of six dice. A 5th-tier smite has fixed damage and accepts only a 5th-level slot.
- **Access.** The table shows the Paladin level and minimum slot for each smite.
- **Saving throws.** Use your spell save DC.
- **Concentration.** A smite marked concentration lasts until your concentration is broken. You can't use it while concentrating on a spell; casting a concentration spell ends the smite. You can concentrate on only one smite at a time. Any smite effect lasting past the end of the target's next turn requires concentration.
- **Limits.** A smite's effect lasts no longer than 1 minute and affects creatures in the fight, not objects or the world.
- **Improved dice.** Each damage die marked `*` increases one size at Paladin 9th level: d6 becomes d8, and d8 becomes d10. This applies to the base damage, added dice from higher-level slots, and the listed maximum.
- **Righteous Strikes.** This path uses psychic damage for Righteous Strikes.

| Tier | Required slot | Paladin level | Concentration |
| ---- | ------------- | ------------- | ------------- |
| 1    | 1st-level     | 2             | Yes           |
| 2    | 2nd-level     | 5             | No            |
| 3    | 3rd-level     | 9             | No            |
| 4    | 4th-level     | 13            | Yes           |
| 5    | 5th-level     | 17            | Yes           |

## Smites

### Cowing Smite

_1st-tier smite · 1st-level slot · Paladin level 2nd+ · concentration_

Your weapon hisses vengeful utterings, and your attack deals an extra 2d8* psychic damage for a 1st-level slot, plus 1d8* for each slot level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 6d8*. Additionally, if the target is a creature, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you for up to 1 minute or until your concentration is broken. An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

### Staggering Smite

_2nd-tier smite · 2nd-level slot · Paladin level 5th+_

The hilt of your weapon takes on a violet hue, and the attack deals an extra 3d6* psychic damage for a 2nd-level slot, plus 1d6* for each slot level higher than 2nd, to a maximum of 6d6*. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, until the end of its next turn it has disadvantage on attack rolls, its speed is halved, and it can't take reactions.

### Enraging Smite

_3rd-tier smite · 3rd-level slot · Paladin level 9th+_

A red mist envelops your weapon, and the attack deals an extra 4d8 psychic damage for a 3rd-level slot, plus 1d8 for each slot level higher than 3rd, to a maximum of 6d8. Additionally, if the target is a creature, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, until the end of its next turn it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you, and creatures other than you make saving throws against its abilities and spells with advantage.

### Humbling Smite

_4th-tier smite · 4th-level slot · Paladin level 13th+ · concentration_

Your weapon pierces both body and mind, and the attack deals an extra 5d10 psychic damage for a 4th-level slot, plus 1d10 for each slot level higher than 4th, to a maximum of 6d10. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, for up to 1 minute or until your concentration is broken, whenever it deals damage to a creature it takes psychic damage equal to half the damage dealt (maximum 10). It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

### Confusing Smite

_5th-tier smite · 5th-level slot · Paladin level 17th+ · concentration_

Your weapon glows with streaks of red light, and the attack deals an extra 6d12 psychic damage for a 5th-level slot. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, for up to 1 minute or until your concentration is broken, it rolls a d6 at the start of each of its turns to decide its behavior for the turn:

| d6  | Behavior                                                                                                              |
| --- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1-2 | It spends all its movement moving in a random direction before acting. Roll a d8 and assign a direction to each face. |
| 3-4 | It can't take reactions and has disadvantage on attack rolls this turn.                                               |
| 5-6 | It acts normally.                                                                                                     |

At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

---

_1st-tier smite · 1st-level slot · Paladin level 2nd+_

_2nd-tier smite · 2nd-level slot · Paladin level 5th+_

### Arcing Smite

_3rd-tier smite · 3rd-level slot · Paladin level 9th+_

Your weapon surges with lightning, and the attack deals an extra 4d8 lightning damage for a 3rd-level slot, plus 1d8 for each slot level higher than 3rd, to a maximum of 6d8. Lightning arcs off the target: up to two other creatures of your choice within 15 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d8 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. _1st-tier smite · 1st-level slot · Paladin level 2nd+_

| ----------------- | ------------------------------------ |

entries.body:
# Artificer

**Masters of invention** | Use magic through tools | Craft magical items and infusions

---

## Quick Overview

**Hit Dice:** 1d8  
**Primary Ability:** Intelligence  
**Saving Throws:** Constitution, Intelligence  
**Skills:** Choose 2 from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Sleight of Hand

Artificers use a variety of tools to channel their arcane power. To cast a spell, an artificer might use alchemist's supplies to create a potent elixir, calligrapher's supplies to inscribe a sigil of power, or tinker's tools to craft a temporary charm. The magic of artificers is tied to their tools and their talents.

**Multiclass Requirement:** You must have an Intelligence score of 13 or higher to multiclass in or out of this class.

---

## Proficiencies

**Armor:** Light armor, medium armor, shields  
**Weapons:** Simple weapons  
**Tools:** Thieves' tools, tinker's tools, one type of artisan's tools of your choice

---

## Progression Table

| Level | Proficiency | Features                                 | Infusions Known | Infused Items | Cantrips | 1st | 2nd | 3rd | 4th | 5th |
| ----- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------- | --------------- | ------------- | -------- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1st   | +2          | Magical Tinkering, Spellcasting          | —               | —             | 2        | 2   | —   | —   | —   | —   |
| 2nd   | +2          | Infuse Item                              | 4               | 2             | 2        | 2   | —   | —   | —   | —   |
| 3rd   | +2          | Artificer Specialization, The Right Tool | 4               | 2             | 2        | 3   | —   | —   | —   | —   |
| 4th   | +2          | Ability Score Improvement                | 4               | 2             | 2        | 3   | —   | —   | —   | —   |
| 5th   | +3          | Specialization feature                   | 4               | 2             | 2        | 4   | 2   | —   | —   | —   |
| 6th   | +3          | Tool Expertise                           | 6               | 3             | 2        | 4   | 2   | —   | —   | —   |
| 7th   | +3          | Flash of Genius                          | 6               | 3             | 2        | 4   | 3   | —   | —   | —   |
| 8th   | +3          | Ability Score Improvement                | 6               | 3             | 2        | 4   | 3   | —   | —   | —   |
| 9th   | +4          | Specialization feature                   | 6               | 3             | 2        | 4   | 3   | 2   | —   | —   |
| 10th  | +4          | Magic Item Adept, Specialization feature | 8               | 4             | 3        | 4   | 3   | 2   | —   | —   |
| 11th  | +4          | Spell-Storing Item                       | 8               | 4             | 3        | 4   | 3   | 3   | —   | —   |
| 12th  | +4          | Ability Score Improvement                | 8               | 4             | 3        | 4   | 3   | 3   | —   | —   |
| 13th  | +5          | —                                        | 8               | 4             | 3        | 4   | 3   | 3   | 1   | —   |
| 14th  | +5          | Magic Item Savant                        | 10              | 5             | 4        | 4   | 3   | 3   | 1   | —   |
| 15th  | +5          | Specialization feature                   | 10              | 5             | 4        | 4   | 3   | 3   | 2   | —   |
| 16th  | +5          | Ability Score Improvement                | 10              | 5             | 4        | 4   | 3   | 3   | 2   | —   |
| 17th  | +6          | —                                        | 10              | 5             | 4        | 4   | 3   | 3   | 3   | 1   |
| 18th  | +6          | Magic Item Master                        | 12              | 6             | 4        | 4   | 3   | 3   | 3   | 1   |
| 19th  | +6          | Ability Score Improvement                | 12              | 6             | 4        | 4   | 3   | 3   | 3   | 2   |
| 20th  | +6          | Soul of Artifice                         | 12              | 6             | 4        | 4   | 3   | 3   | 3   | 2   |

---

## Key Class Features

### Magical Tinkering (1st Level)

You can invest a spark of magic into mundane objects. You must have thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand. Touch a Tiny nonmagical object and give it one magical property:

- Sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for 5 more feet
- Emits a recorded message (up to 6 seconds) when tapped
- Continuously emits an odor or nonverbal sound (perceivable up to 10 feet)
- Displays a static visual effect (picture, text, lines, shapes)

You can affect a number of objects equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). If you exceed your maximum, the oldest property ends.

### Spellcasting (1st Level)

You cast spells through your tools. You must have a spellcasting focus (thieves' tools or artisan's tool) in hand to cast any spell with the spellcasting feature.

**Browse available Artificer spells by level:**

![[artificer-spells.base]]

This catalogue reflects the spells currently tagged for Artificers in this archive; it is not a complete official Artificer list. SRD 5.1 does not include the Artificer class. The Source column identifies each spell entry's source, not the supplement that establishes Artificer access.

**Cantrips:** You know 2 cantrips at 1st level, gaining more at higher levels (see table).

**Spell Slots:** You prepare spells equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your level (rounded down), minimum 1.

**Spellcasting Ability:** Intelligence

- **Spell Save DC** = 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier
- **Spell Attack Modifier** = proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier

You can cast artificer spells as rituals if the spell has the ritual tag and you have it prepared.

### Infuse Item (2nd Level)

At the end of a long rest, you can touch a nonmagical object and imbue it with one of your artificer infusions. You know 4 infusions at 2nd level and learn more at higher levels. You can infuse a number of items equal to your level (see progression table).

### Artificer Specialization (3rd Level)

At 3rd level, choose one Artificer Specialization. It grants features at the levels listed in its description. The available specializations in this archive are [[Agent]], [[Forgebound]], [[Grenadier]], [[Lycanist]], [[Ooze Rancher]], [[Static Conductor]], [[Venomist]], and [[Wagoneer]]. Browse them in the [[character-options/subclasses/Artificer/index|Artificer Specializations index]].

### The Right Tool for the Job (3rd Level)

With thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand, you can magically create one set of artisan's tools in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. This requires 1 hour of uninterrupted work (can coincide with a short or long rest). The tools vanish when you use this feature again.

### Tool Expertise (6th Level)

Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check using your tool proficiency.

### Flash of Genius (7th Level)

When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an ability check or saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll.

Uses: Equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). Regain on long rest.

### Magic Item Adept (10th Level)

- You can attune to up to 4 magic items at once
- If you craft a magic item of common or uncommon rarity, it takes 1/4 normal time and costs 1/2 normal gold

### Spell-Storing Item (11th Level)

At the end of a long rest, you can touch a simple or martial weapon or spellcasting focus and store a 1st- or 2nd-level spell (that takes 1 action to cast) in it. A creature holding the object can use an action to produce the spell's effect using your spellcasting ability.

The spell stays until used a number of times equal to 2 × your Intelligence modifier (minimum 2).

### Magic Item Savant (14th Level)

- You can attune to up to 5 magic items at once
- You ignore all class, race, spell, and level requirements on magic item attunement and use

### Magic Item Master (18th Level)

You can attune to up to 6 magic items at once.

### Soul of Artifice (20th Level)

You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws per magic item you're attuned to.

If reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can use your reaction to end one of your infusions, causing you to drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.

---

## Starting Equipment

Choose one or both:

- Any two simple weapons
- A light crossbow and 20 bolts

Choose one:

- Studded leather armor, or
- Scale mail

Always gain:

- Thieves' tools and a dungeoneer's pack

**Alternative:** 5d4 × 10 gold pieces

---

## Spellcasting Notes

**Tools Required:** You need a spellcasting focus (thieves' tools or artisan's tools) in hand when casting artificer spells.

**Prepared Spells:** You prepare a number of spells equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your level (minimum 1). Change your prepared list after each long rest.

**Ritual Casting:** Cast spells with the ritual tag as rituals without using a spell slot.

---

## Artificer Specializations

Choose from the eight specializations in the [[character-options/subclasses/Artificer/index|specialization index]]: [[Agent]], [[Forgebound]], [[Grenadier]], [[Lycanist]], [[Ooze Rancher]], [[Static Conductor]], [[Venomist]], and [[Wagoneer]].

---

## Optional Rules

**Firearm Proficiency:** If your DM uses firearms rules, and you've been exposed to guns, you're proficient with them.

---
