entries.title: Light-Touched
entries.summary: Medium; speed 30 ft.; +2 Charisma; subraces Goldenborn, Iridescent

frontmatter.title: Light-Touched
frontmatter.summary: Medium; speed 30 ft.; +2 Charisma; subraces Goldenborn, Iridescent

entries.body:
> I've seen the look in her eyes, bright as the sun it was. She was there to scorch me. "Oh," I exclaimed, "I'm through with filching. Promise!" She looked at me and I saw mercy in her glowing eyes. She let me live and I never stole another thing again. Never again...
>
> Bernard, an ex-thief talking about a light-touched paladin

The light-touched are beacons of all that is good, a beam that illuminates the darkest of nights, the purest of souls. They are creatures of light. They were touched by it and carry its blessing wherever they go, representing the light, standing tall against the forces of evil.

## Glamorous

Every light-touched has special physical properties indicating that they were touched by the light. You carry distinctive marks on your body that shine bright with the color of their innate light. Your eyes and hair emit a glaring, dazzling light. Your body glows in the dark and can illuminate your surroundings. This innate light of yours may be golden as the sun, silvery as the moonshine, or prismatic.

## Consecrated by the Light

The origins of the light-touched vary; however, all are somewhat connected to other realms of existence or angelic creatures of such realms. Your parents may be the followers of a God or Goddess of light and may have received said deity's blessings. You may be the inhabitants of a realm of light where everything consists of radiant energy. Whatever the source of your existence is, you carry the light and as bright and pure as it can get.

## Light-Touched in Society

A light-touched is a rare sighting in a city, not because they are excluded from society, but because they are uncommon creatures.

Light-toucheds try to build peaceful relationships with others. Although their astonishing appearance certainly helps with that, the real reason they are successful in doing so is that they make great warriors, spellcasters, politicians, and so on. They bring solace to the souls of their friends and agony to their foes.

## Light-Touched Names

Most light-touched creatures are native to a realm consisting only of light and have names representing their specific gleaming nature. However, a god of light may bestow its blessing upon a baby whose parents are not light-touched. In such cases, they may have names adopted by other cultures.

Also, the light-touched may go by names that indicate the color of their innate light, such as "the Red", or "the Golden".

**Male names:** Bright, Candle, Dawn, Gleam, Shine, Sunny  
**Female names:** Aurora, Chiara, Glitter, Eileen, Skye, Starlight

## Light-Touched Traits

Your light-touched character has a number of traits originating from its light within.

**Ability score increase:** Your Charisma score increases by 2.  
**Age:** The light-touched reach physical maturity and are considered adults at about the same age as humans; however, they live up to 500 years.  
**Alignment:** The light-touched are creatures of light. They are mostly restless fighters against the darkness, the emissaries of mercy, vitality, and hope. Therefore, most of the light-touched favor good alignments, though their ways of achieving the good may vary.  
**Size:** The light-touched have skinnier builds than the average human. Their height ranges from 5 to 6 feet. Your size is Medium.  
**Speed:** Your base walking speed is 30 feet.  
**Language:** You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

> [!info]- Creatures of Light
> You know the dancing lights and the light cantrips. In addition, when you reach 5th level, you can cast the daylight spell once per day.

> [!info]- Glowing Bodies
> You have a mark on your body that glows and emits a bright light as in the light cantrip. The light of your mark can be covered by 1 inch of common clothing or by similar materials. You have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when you are in a lightly or heavily obscured area unless you cover your innate glow. You also have resistance to radiant damage.

> [!info]- Radiant Form
> As a bonus action, your whole body emanates intense light, and you can take a humanoid form made of radiant energy (transforming with your equipment) and gain the following traits:
>
> - You gain immunity to radiant damage and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
>
> - You can move through a space as narrow as 1-inch wide without squeezing.
>
> - You have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
>
> You remain in the radiant form until the end of your next turn. Once you use this form, you have to finish a short or long rest to use it again.

> [!info]- Strangers to Darkness
> If a light-touched has had no contact with daylight for three consecutive days, its light slowly fades. Your hit point maximum decreases by 1 each time you finish a long rest, and you suffer one level of exhaustion (that can't be removed until you see the daylight again for 1 hour). The required daylight can be imitated with the daylight spell or any other spell of 3rd level or higher which radiates light. When you finish a long rest after you get in contact with daylight, your previous hit point maximum is restored and you no longer suffer from one level of exhaustion.

**Subrace.** The light-touched have three subraces according to the type of light they host and each subrace has specific magical benefits bestowed upon them.

## Goldenborn

Your body emanates light in a form resembling sunlight. Your golden radiance soothes the souls of the innocent and strikes fear into the hearts of the forces of darkness.

**Ability score increase:** Your Constitution score increases by 1.

> [!info]- Wrath of the Light
> As a bonus action, you can focus and channel the power of your innate light to your hand for 1 minute. When you make a melee attack, your attack deals an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit. This extra damage increases to 1d6 at 6th, 1d8 at 12th, and 1d10 at 18th level.
>
> If you hit with an attack on which you used the Wrath of the Light trait while in radiant form, you are considered to have dealt the highest possible damage for your extra radiant damage.
>
> Once you use this trait, you must finish a short or long rest to use it again.

## Iridescent Ones

Your body glows with rainbow-colored lights that weave and fade into one another and change as you move, making you a very pleasant sight to behold.

Iridescents generally have artistic souls and a natural ability to blend in with almost any crowd.

**Ability score increase:** One of the ability scores of your choice increases by 1.

> [!info]- Natural Born Artists
> You gain proficiency with an artisan's tool of your choice.

> [!info]- Prismatic
> You are iridescent; you shine with different prismatic colors that interlock and change with every step you take; each step making you more elegant than before. However, some iridescents may prefer to settle down and choose a stable or signature color with which to shine. As a bonus action, you can choose the color of light your body radiates.

> [!info]- Social Beings
> You have the ability to blend in with different crowds and to adapt, even in the face of the harshest of conditions. You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Insight or Persuasion.

## Silver Born

Your body exudes a graceful, silver light. All light-touched have an understanding of magic, but silverborns have a natural talent or deeper passion for the magic of all sorts, so do you.

**Ability score increase:** One of the following ability scores of your choice increases by 1: Wisdom or Intelligence.

> [!info]- Radiant Magic
> You can change the damage type of any spell that deals damage to radiant damage. In addition, your spell save DC increases by one for spells that originally deal radiant damage.

_From Corpus Angelus._

entries.title: Peri
entries.summary: Medium fey; speed 30 ft.; +2 Charisma; subraces Curiosity, Love, and Valor

frontmatter.title: Peri
frontmatter.summary: Medium fey; speed 30 ft.; +2 Charisma; subraces Curiosity, Love, and Valor

entries.body:
> There they were on stage, with their performance illuminated by magical flakes. The audience gasped in astonishment as the naked figures moved their bodies closer to each other. Then, a red flame burst upon the stage and I saw her. She was beautiful, they were all beautiful and were as naked as the top of my bald head. It was the first time ever that I witnessed such courage from those so alien but so familiar at the same time. They taught us not to be ashamed of love.
>
> Isadore Faustus, a student of poetry

The peri are a carefree folk that believe in the power of experiencing life rather than understanding it. Peris are a mystical people of ardent emotions, trying to sympathize with the actions of other people who are driven by strong sentiment. They mostly settle near elves and benevolent people capable of love. It is common for them to choose professions that appeal to their heightened senses, such as baking, brewing, gardening, painting, and singing. Most of them are peaceful and very few of them dare to venture to places of conflict.

## Marked Bodies

Every peri has marks on their body, resembling tattoos. These marks mostly cover the most sensitive parts of the body, such as the mouth or the eyes.

Although their skin tones generally vary between shades of green, they can have skin of any color. They usually stand out in crowds; on average, they are taller than most humans. Peris stand between 5 and 7 feet tall and usually weigh between 180 and 260 pounds. Their large proportions compared to other fey races may scare some at first sight.

## Extreme Attitudes

Sadness, happiness, fear, anger, and similar emotions may fill a human soul in the blink of an eye, only to leave in a hurry a moment later. But once a feeling affects a peri, it stays with them until it reaches the extreme. They usually choose to channel these extreme emotions for harmless endeavors or to push themselves towards their goals. There are some peris who find comfort in diverting their focus on hostile actions, although they are a small percentage of the whole.

One of the defining qualities of peris is that they want to experience many things in life to the fullest and rarely avoid or deny their emotions, even undesirable ones such as fear or anger. They are not afraid of feeling unfavorable emotions. To keep control while under the influence of such feelings is a special skill that almost all peris must master at an early age to keep from causing unintentional harm. While they are still young, peris choose an emotion or a state of mind or spirit to which they can anchor their senses in times of crisis. Over the course of their lives, they master the emotion or the virtue that they have chosen and become the ultimate representation of it. Thus, they have something to turn to if they are led astray by their passion.

## Flavorful Culture

Having extremely developed senses, peris chase after a variety of refined tastes, and most of them agree on the importance of hot beverages. They consume a wide range of teas made of various fruits, herbs, and root vegetables, as well as some alchemical mixtures. The earthly aromas, the warmth and sound of boiling water, and the beauty of colorful ingredients gently appeal to all their sharp senses. Some of them even craft elegant vessels to hold such beverages, and even decorate them for better presentation.

In addition to beverages, peris value spices, perfumes, clothes, and wind chimes. Every small peri tribe is ruled by a peri who has mastered the art of crafting one of these things or something else that appeals to the senses in the same way. Each tribe produces the specific commodity mastered by their ruler, and then exports them for others to enjoy. They mostly live in small settlements near large bodies of water, in houses made of driftwood, mud and stone.

## Peri Names

Peris are not given names by their parents. At some point in their childhood, they begin to discover their names.

At that point, other peris intuitively start to call the youngling by incomplete versions of its name. For some time, which could vary from a week to a year, all those different names start to meld into one. A peri chooses whether it wants to adopt the name that emerges from this combination or wishes to have a completely different name.

**Incomplete names:** Ay, Ae, Bo, Du, El, Fen, Gu, Hiu, Kin, Lia, Lem, Nu, Pak, Ra, Riu, Sva, Tea, Uu, Vlo, Yad, Zel, Zil  
**Male names:** Aykin, Bovlo, Efen, Hiuzil, Kindu, Lialemea, Ravlo, Uuzil, Yadrenad  
**Female names:** Ayra, Cieli, Duru, Elen, Iltea, Kosvara, Miuu, Nufen, Olia, Svana, Zelre

## Peri Traits

Your fey nature blesses you with a variety of mystical traits that you share with other peris.

**Ability score increase:** Your Charisma score increases by 2.  
**Age:** Peris reach maturity at age 20 and can live to be 1200 years old.  
**Alignment:** Because of their mystical nature with a close connection to emotions, peris can easily empathize with people. They tend to be kind, caring, chaotic, and unpredictable; although they generally have good intentions.  
**Size:** Peris stand between 5 and 7 feet tall. They have well-built bodies and weigh between 180 and 260 pounds. Your size is Medium.  
**Speed:** Your base walking speed is 30 feet.  
**Languages:** You can speak, read, and write Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.

> [!info]- Creature Type
> Your creature type is Fey.

> [!info]- Darkvision
> Your magical nature grants you sight, even in the darkest of environments. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

> [!info]- Empathy
> You have proficiency in the Insight skill.

> [!info]- Fey Endurance
> You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

> [!info]- Marked Senses
> You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

> [!info]- Tea Expert
> You gain proficiency with teamaker's tools. In addition, you can discern every single aroma in food or drink, and determine whether it is poisoned or not.

> [!info]- Tool Proficiency
> You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

**Subrace.** While they are still young, every peri chooses an emotion or a value to hold onto when they encounter hardships. These emotions or values determine their capabilities as adults.

## Curiosity Peri

You favor the thrill of experiencing new things. You have a deep-seated desire and ambition to learn, and your very essence is pure curiosity. Your observant nature enables you to focus on small details that others might miss and gives you an innate understanding of different languages.

**Ability score increase:** Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

> [!info]- Truthful Memory
> For a short while, your senses remember the things you experienced perfectly. You can make a Wisdom (Perception) skill check to perceive something that you perceived within the last minute using one of your senses, even if you can no longer perceive it. You can attempt to do so once every minute.

> [!info]- Shared Tongue
> You can cast the comprehend languages spell once using this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest.

## Love Peri

When challenged by hardships, these peris hold on to positive feelings, such as joy, serenity, and love. They are also capable of sharing these emotions with others and spreading the love they carry within. Their affection makes them attractive to almost everyone they meet.

**Ability score increase:** Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

> [!info]- Aesthetic of Good
> You have proficiency in the Performance skill.

> [!info]- Charming Glamor
> You can cast charm person as a 1st level spell once using this trait. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You regain the ability to cast the spell using this trait when you finish a short or long rest.

## Valor Peri

As a valor peri, you can channel your extreme emotions into hostile action. By doing so, you can hold your ground against the most formidable enemies, even when the odds are against you. You are aware that combat and hostility can also be used as tools to do good.

**Ability score increase:** Your Strength score increases by 1.

> [!info]- Brave
> You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

> [!info]- Tests of Bravery
> Through self-appointed tests of bravery, you learn to use great weapons as a symbol of your great courage. You have proficiency with the greataxe, greatsword, longbow, and maul.

_From Corpus Angelus._

entries.title: Redeemed Fiend
entries.summary: Medium fiend; speed 30 ft.; +2 Wisdom; subraces Redeemed

frontmatter.title: Redeemed Fiend
frontmatter.summary: Medium fiend; speed 30 ft.; +2 Wisdom; subraces Redeemed

entries.body:
Fiends are known to be evil, ruthless, destructive, and hateful; basically the opposite of everything good. They are not only evil, evil and malevolence make up their very nature. They delight in pain and they do not know what mercy is. They do not easily change their ways either. Nevertheless, they are intelligent, capable of learning, and susceptible to change. Further, although redemption is extremely rare and difficult for a fiend, it is not impossible.

Their appearance varies since fiends vary in shape, but they look indomitable and lurid by nature. A redeemed fiend buries its past deep within and only looks back to learn from the grave mistakes it has made. Thankful for a clean slate undefiled by its past, a redeemed fiend seeks out the ways of the good, discovering the world anew.

> I thought I was done for when I saw it coming at me baring its teeth, but it turns out it was smiling at me. I imagined it'd introduce me to my maker when it reached for me with its razor-sharp claws, but it held my hand and gave me a bunch of coins instead. A whole damn pouch of 'em! All those priests, clerics passed me by; they hadn't even cared to take a look at us, did they? But, it... it... Cared...
>
> Clementine, a former beggar, a cleric of light

## Redemption

There are several ways to redeem oneself. For instance, there are angels powerful enough to place a shard of goodness inside a fiend by looking into its eyes and sacrificing a part of its own angelic soul for the greater good; a shard of good to make the foulest of souls question their life path... A shard of good that may, perhaps, turn evil into good.

Although very rare, there are some fiends whose lives of thousands of years granted them an understanding beyond the limitations of their nature and the traditions of their existence. Those fiends retreat and live in seclusion for hundreds of years, trying to blunt their malevolence. A few of those who live in seclusion succeed to sunder their nature and are redeemed through solitude and the wisdom they find within.

Strong emotions can also lead a fiend to redemption; a fiend can fall in love with an angel, or a devil can question the orders that caused its best friend's death, which can lead them to the paths of the righteous.

## Fiendish Bloodline

Being a redeemed fiend is not easy, those who are redeemed lose most of their powers that are the legacy of their heritage. If a fiend somehow gets redeemed, its ideology, mindset, and the way it perceives the world changes, making it harder for it to use its former powers. Once the redeemed fiend goes through life enough for it to embrace its true self and accept that these powers once serving evil can now serve a good purpose, it slowly regains the courage to use some of them again.

## A Secluded Life

Once evil incarnate, a fiend commits crimes both against the agents of good and the agents of evil. Due to its past, a redeemed fiend has lots of enemies that are both good and evil, whom the GM may determine and make part of the game.

Although changed, a redeemed fiend retains its appearance and its creature type, which scares folk that cross its path, and this causes redeemed fiends to mostly keep to themselves in society. They carry the full weight of the heavy burden of their past upon their shoulders. People find it hard to get close to redeemed fiends and even harder to trust them.

## Redeemed Fiend Names

**Male names:** Adramalech, Cresil, Melchom, Naburus  
**Female names:** Astarte, Hecate, Kali, Naamah

## Redeemed Fiend Traits

Your redeemed fiend character has certain traits that are the legacy of your fiendish ancestry:

**Ability score increase:** Your Wisdom score increases by 2.  
**Age:** A fiend dying of old age is not a common sight to behold. However, when redeemed, they have to sacrifice their immortality. They do not get old and have 200 more years to live after being redeemed.  
**Size:** Redeemed fiends' size and appearances vary greatly. However, they are mostly between 5 and 7 feet tall and weigh between 220 and 260 pounds. Your size is Medium.  
**Speed:** Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

> [!info]- Creature Type
> You are a fiend rather than a humanoid. You retained your fiendish form when you were redeemed.

> [!info]- Holy Pact
> When you are redeemed, you agree to an unrelenting holy pact. You thus simply cease to exist if you commit evil acts, and your alignment shifts to evil. Shifts in your alignment are determined at the GM's discretion.

> [!info]- Darkvision
> You once ruled over the darkness, which is why you are accustomed to it. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

> [!info]- Fiendish Heritage
> You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed and frightened.

> [!info]- Fiend's Lifestyle
> As a fiend, you've been on many adventures and seen things that most mortals could only imagine. Although you are redeemed, the memory of all that you've seen stays with you. Due to your past experiences, you have proficiency in two skills of your choice.

> [!info]- Unpopular
> Commonfolk try to avoid you and do not trust you. You have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against them while in your true form.

**Subrace.** Redemption leads to different outcomes for different types of fiends. The subrace of each redeemed fiend is determined according to their former self.

## Redeemed Succubus/Incubus

Charming, lustful, and deadly; succubi/incubi are some of the most dangerous beings of the lower planes. When redeemed, their lust turns into affection, and their deadly kiss turns into a touch of warmth. Retaining their true forms as well as their shapechanging ability, they look however they please. When you choose this subrace, you gain the following benefits:

**Alignment:** Most redeemed succubi/incubi are neutral good; however, there can be redeemed succubi/incubi of any non-evil alignment.  
**Ability score increase:** Your Charisma score increases by 1.  
**Language:** You can speak, read, and write Common, and Abyssal or Infernal.

> [!info]- Demon's Claws
> Although you have kept some of your bloodline features, some of them went blunt when you were redeemed. However, as time goes by, and as you adapt more and more to your new lifestyle, you rediscover that you can, in fact, use the features you retained for the better. As a bonus action, you can grow claws that deal 1d6 slashing damage (each) while in your true form or you can reduce them and put them away.

> [!info]- Fiend's Wings
> Due to your fiendish heritage, you have bat-like wings. Although your wings lose some of their former functions when you are redeemed, you can still use them in some ways.
>
> Your jump distance is doubled and you can glide while falling; your rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round, you do not take any falling damage, and you can land on your feet.

> [!info]- Invigorating Kiss
> As an action, you kiss a creature. The target regains a number of hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). A creature can benefit from this feature once until it finishes a long rest.

> [!info]- Shapechanger
> As an action, you can polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid or back into your true form. Without wings, you lose their benefits. Other than your size and speed, your statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying isn't transformed. You revert to your true form if you die.
>
> Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest to use it again.

## Redeemed Chain Devil

Born of hate, mischief, and (of course) chains, chain devils are brutal creatures of the lower planes. Their bodies are composed of chains that can be used as deadly weapons or tools to enslave their foes. The painful screams of those they torture are music to their ears.

The memories of these horrid acts are burdens that redeemed chain devils must bear. They keep their appearance as it was; however, they overcome the evil within when redeemed. Redeemed chain devils generally devote themselves to be followers of law and order, punishing those who commit evil, mostly under the guidance of a good-aligned temple. When you choose this subrace, you gain the following benefits:

**Alignment:** Most redeemed chain devils are lawful good; however, there can be redeemed chain devils of any non-evil alignment.  
**Ability score increase:** Your Strength or Constitution score (one of your choice) increases by 1.  
**Language:** You can speak, read, and write Common and Infernal.

> [!info]- Devil's Chains
> You once used your chains to enslave your foes, but you came to understand that you could also use them for good when you were redeemed. You can use your chains to make a melee weapon attack. The chain has the following properties: It is a simple melee weapon that has the reach and finesse properties. On a hit, it deals 1d8 slashing damage, and the target is grappled (DC equal to 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus).

> [!info]- Devil's Eyes
> Magical darkness doesn't impede your darkvision.

> [!info]- Heartening Mask
> You choose a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see. As a bonus action, you create an illusion of one of the target's loved ones to comfort it. The target has advantage on the next saving throw within 1 minute. If the target is already affected by a magical effect, it can repeat its saving throw against it, ending the effect on itself on a success.
>
> Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest to use it again.

_From Corpus Angelus._

entries.summary: Medium; speed 30 ft.; +2 Wisdom and +1 to three scores of your choice;

frontmatter.title: Stranger
frontmatter.summary: Medium; speed 30 ft.; +2 Wisdom and +1 to three scores of your choice;

entries.body:
> The latest specimen was the first one we found with all its limbs and vital organs intact; however, it was frozen. We took its measurements and started our tests to determine its age. My sorcerer colleagues started to unfreeze the chunks of ice covering the specimen without damaging the flesh. The moment I realized our specimen had been in ice for 10 years, it opened its eyes. Thanks to the cleric we had with us, he now happily lives in a human village with a wife and two children; 8 years after the incident.
>
> Grillia, an Elven Anthropologist

Ancient, evil forces desperately tried to create a race that could establish its supremacy over others and take control of all material existence. They forged creatures out of flesh, thunder, and magic. These creatures were truly immortal, extremely fierce, and fast on the uptake, yet, they were not obedient. Evil tried its many tricks on these creatures, they even gave them souls to bind and chain. Every single time, these creatures found ways to break free from their masters, and eventually, they started to ward off evil's attempts of enslavement effortlessly.

## Nameless and Cursed

They were not given a name upon their creation, not even a true name, as evil forces didn't want others to be able to take control of their precious creation. Ironically, their creations took control of themselves and started to decide their own fate, calling themselves the "nameless". When the first nameless was struck down, they learned there were limits to their immortality. They tasted the fear of dying, of losing a loved one, and of the great unknown. Motivated by this fear, they fought back much more vigorously than before. They knew that this angst had to be their burden, and that evil had to be stopped before its wickedness spread further. Countless times, they fought back and countless times, they lost. Every time, they lost a little more of themselves, being cursed again and again by their former masters and current defeators until they lost so much power that they were no longer the concern of evil powers.

## Lost Eternity, Earned Glory

Right before the evil powers that had made the nameless turned their attention elsewhere, they bestowed their final and greatest curse on their creation; mortality. A final curse was placed in their hearts to symbolize their evil origins. With a lifespan of 66 years, they searched for their place among other mortal races. They scattered across worlds and settled near anyone who had a kind heart. They searched for good people to leave their pasts, their masters, and all the evil they witnessed behind.

## Different but the Same

The nameless lived in various societies, masquerading as humans. Two things gave them away; their crackling thunderous voice and the blue veins covering parts of their bodies. Some of the nameless started to feel ashamed because they were different from the rest, and this always warranted a reaction one way or another. They adopt different cultures as humans do and lead honest lives, readying themselves and their loved ones to fight back against evil if that day ever comes.

## Stranger Names

When the nameless settled in various societies, they were called (a variety of the word) "strangers" and the name stuck. After some time, the nameless embraced this new name as well. They don't have names and true names, thus, they are not good with names and any concept they bring with them. A stranger usually adopts a name given to them by a loved one or an important enemy.

## Stranger Traits

A speck of strength left from your glorious self and the burden of your curse present themselves in the form of the following traits:

**Ability score increase:** Your Wisdom score increases by 2 and three ability scores of your choice each increase by 1.  
**Age:** Strangers reach maturity at age 5. Because of the curse placed on their hearts, they die when they turn 66.  
**Alignment:** Most strangers do not like the confines of rules and regulations as it reminds them too much of their past, and thus tend to lead chaotic lives. They also try to be as different from their creators as possible, leaning towards good and trying to walk a path of righteousness to the best of their abilities.  
**Size:** Strangers stand as tall as humans, averaging at about 6 feet. Your size is Medium.  
**Speed:** Your base walking speed is 30 feet.  
**Languages:** You can speak, read, and write Common, Abyssal, Infernal, and one language of your choice.

> [!info]- Curse of Death
> When you turn 13, dark blue veins start to spread across your body, originating from your heart. When you turn 66, you die. Also because of this condition, Wisdom (Medicine) checks to stabilize you are made with disadvantage.

> [!info]- Curse and Strength
> Your ancestral strengths and curses occur in various severity. This condition determines your inherited strength and weakness. Roll on the two tables below, or choose one curse from the Curses table and one strength from the Strengths table.

### Strengths

| d6  | Strength                                                                                                                                                            |
| --- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Backup Organs. Any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.                                                                                                   |
| 2   | Borrowed Gift. You channel the power of your creators by force. Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage. This damage increases to 2d6 against fiends. |
| 3   | Deep Sleep. When you suffer 6 levels of exhaustion, you don't die, you remain unconscious instead.                                                                  |
| 4   | Mithridatism. You have resistance to poison damage and immunity against being poisoned.                                                                             |
| 5   | Efficient Metabolism. You can survive for a month without food or water, and you can hold your breath for one hour before you start suffocating.                    |
| 6   | Persistent Existence. Your hit point maximum can't be reduced by any means.                                                                                         |

### Curses

| d6  | Curse                                                                                                                                                            |
| --- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Cursed Hands. You can't wield weapons that have metal parts. Any attempt to do so automatically fails and the weapon falls to the ground.                        |
| 2   | Cursed Soul. You can be attuned to no more than two magic items at a time.                                                                                       |
| 3   | Cursed Smell. Any beast within 150 feet of you is automatically aware of your location, and considers you a threat.                                              |
| 4   | Cursed Feet. You can't take the Dash action.                                                                                                                     |
| 5   | Cursed Mouth. When a creature uses magical means to discern whether you are telling the truth or not, it always concludes that you're lying, even if you aren't. |
| 6   | Cursed Emotions. You can't regain hit points by any means while charmed or frightened.                                                                           |

> [!info]- Darkvision
> You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

> [!info]- Voice of Thunder
> Your voice is like crackling thunder. If you use your voice during an intimidation attempt, you have advantage on your Charisma (Intimidation) check.

_From Corpus Angelus._

entries.body:
**Ability score increase:** +1 INT, +2 CHA  
**Age:** Tieflings mature at the same rate as humans but live a few years longer.  
**Alignment:** Tieflings might not have an innate tendency toward evil, but many of them end up there. Evil or not, an independent nature inclines many tieflings toward a chaotic alignment.  
**Size:** Tieflings are about the same size and build as humans. Your size is Medium.  
**Speed:** 30 feet  
**Languages:** You can speak, read, and write Common and Infernal.

## Traits

> [!info]- Darkvision
> You have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. Detailed in [[rules/adventuring/vision-and-light|Vision and Light]]. You cannot discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

> [!info]- Hellish Resistance
> You have [[rules/combat/damage-and-healing|resistance]] to fire damage.

> [!info]- Infernal Legacy
> You know the [[spells/cantrips/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]] cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the [[spells/1st-level/Hellish Rebuke|hellish rebuke]] spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a [[rules/adventuring/resting|long rest]]. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the [[spells/2nd-level/Darkness|darkness]] spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

entries.summary: Marks and studies a chosen quarry

frontmatter.title: Agent
frontmatter.summary: Marks and studies a chosen quarry

entries.body:
# Agent

Agents use their inventions and magic to pursue quarry, gather information, and capture their targets.

## Agent Features

| Artificer Level | Feature                                                            |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 3rd             | Seeking Sight, Tools of the Trade, Agent Spells, Arcane Restraints |
| 5th             | Enhanced Sight, Extra Attack                                       |
| 9th             | Defensive Maneuvers                                                |
| 15th            | Master Agent                                                       |

## Seeking Sight

_3rd-level Agent feature_

You have crafted a wondrous device to aid you in pursuing your foes. Over the course of 1 hour, which can be during a short or long rest, you can use a set of tools to craft a Tiny object. You can have only one such object.

While wearing the object, you can use a bonus action to place an arcane mark on a creature or object you can see within 60 feet. The mark grants you the following benefits against the marked target:

- Whenever you make a Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check related to it, you gain a bonus to the roll equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1).
- You can use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with weapons bearing one of your infusions.
- You always know the direction and distance to it while you are on the same plane of existence.

The mark lasts for 1 hour, but ends early if you mark another target or use a bonus action to end it. If the marked target is slain, you can use your reaction to mark another target you can see within range.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest. If you have no uses remaining, you can expend a spell slot to use it again.

## Tools of the Trade

_3rd-level Agent feature_

You gain proficiency with martial weapons and smith's tools. If you are already proficient with smith's tools, you instead gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

## Agent Spells

_3rd-level Agent feature_

You always have the following spells prepared. They don't count against the number of spells you can prepare.

| Artificer Level | Spells                               |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| 3rd             | _Ensnaring strike, [[Grease]]_       |
| 5th             | _[[Locate Creature]], [[Web]]_       |
| 9th             | _[[Clairvoyance]], [[Nondetection]]_ |
| 13th            | _[[Arcane Eye]], [[Divination]]_     |
| 17th            | _[[Hold Monster]], [[Legend Lore]]_  |

## Arcane Restraints

_3rd-level Agent feature_

Once per turn when you hit your marked target with a weapon bearing one of your infusions, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it is restrained, and your mark immediately ends. As an action, the target or another creature within 5 feet of it can make a Strength check against your spell save DC, ending the restrained condition on a success. The condition also ends if the target takes any damage.

## Enhanced Sight

_5th-level Agent feature_

When you mark a target with Seeking Sight, you immediately learn one of the following characteristics of your choice:

- Its spellcasting ability modifier and the level of its highest-level spell.
- Its creature type, alignment, and one language it speaks.
- Its civilization of origin and approximate age.

## Extra Attack

_5th-level Agent feature_

You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. Moreover, you can cast one of your artificer cantrips in place of one of these attacks.

## Defensive Maneuvers

_9th-level Agent feature_

You gain the following reactions:

- When your marked target makes an attack against you that you can see, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to your AC against that attack.
- When your marked target misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, you knock it prone or grapple it (your choice). You must have a free hand to grapple it this way.

## Master Agent

_15th-level Agent feature_

Your marked target has disadvantage on any attack roll it makes against you and on the first saving throw you force it to make on each of your turns.

_From user-provided Artificer specialization material._

entries.body:
# Forgebound

Forgebound artificers bind part of their soul to a companion capable of spontaneously generating weapons. Together, they coordinate attacks and share magic.

## Forgebound Features

| Artificer Level | Feature                                                |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| 3rd             | Tools of the Trade, Forge Companion, Forgebound Spells |
| 5th             | Extra Attack                                           |
| 10th            | Coordinated Combatants                                 |
| 15th            | Master Forgebound                                      |

## Tools of the Trade

_3rd-level Forgebound feature_

You gain proficiency with smith's tools and martial weapons. If you are already proficient with smith's tools, you gain proficiency with another type of artisan's tools of your choice.

## Forge Companion

_3rd-level Forgebound feature_

You create a faithful Forge Companion. It is friendly to you and obeys your orders. Its game statistics appear below and use your spell save DC, proficiency bonus (PB), and Intelligence modifier.

**Creating a Companion.** During a long rest, you can spend 1 hour using smith's tools to create a Forge Companion. You can have only one companion; creating another destroys the previous one. If your companion dies, you can expend a spell slot and spend 1 minute repairing it with smith's tools, restoring it to life with its maximum hit points.

**Infusions.** When the companion uses Conjure Armament, it can apply one of your infusions to that weapon, provided you meet the infusion's prerequisites.

**Combat.** In combat, your companion acts during your turn. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but it takes only the Dodge action unless you use a bonus action to order it to take an action in its stat block or another action. If you are incapacitated, the companion acts on its own to defend you to the best of its ability.

**Spellcasting Focus.** Weapons created with Conjure Armament can be used as a spellcasting focus for your artificer spells.

### Forge Companion

_Medium construct, unaligned_

| Statistic            | Value                                         |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| Armor Class          | 13 + PB (natural armor)                       |
| Hit Points           | 5 + five times your Artificer level           |
| Speed                | 30 ft.                                        |
| Damage Immunities    | Poison, psychic                               |
| Condition Immunities | Charmed, exhaustion, poisoned                 |
| Senses               | Darkvision 60 ft.; passive Perception 10 + PB |
| Languages            | Understands the languages you speak           |

**STR** 16 (+3), **DEX** 12 (+1), **CON** 14 (+2), **INT** 4 (−3), **WIS** 10 (+0), **CHA** 6 (−2)

**Hit Dice.** The companion has a number of d8 Hit Dice equal to your Artificer level and gains the normal benefits of short and long rests.

**Might of the Master.** Add your PB to any ability check or saving throw the companion makes.

#### Actions

**Conjure Armament.** The companion instantaneously creates a simple or martial weapon, causing it to appear in its creator's hand. This weapon is magical and deals force damage instead of its normal damage type on a hit. It disappears if dropped or if the companion creates another weapon.

**Slam.** _Melee Weapon Attack:_ your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier force damage.

## Forgebound Spells

_3rd-level Forgebound feature_

You always have the following spells prepared. They don't count against the number of spells you can prepare.

| Artificer Level | Spells                                     |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| 3rd             | _[[Longstrider]], zephyr strike_           |
| 5th             | _[[Heat Metal]], [[Misty Step]]_           |
| 9th             | _[[Haste]], conjure volley_                |
| 13th            | _[[Fire Shield]], [[Freedom of Movement]]_ |
| 17th            | _Banishing smite, steel wind strike_       |

## Extra Attack

_5th-level Forgebound feature_

You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. Moreover, when you cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action, you can make one melee attack as a bonus action on that turn.

## Coordinated Combatants

_10th-level Forgebound feature_

When you and your companion are both within 5 feet of the same creature, you both have advantage on attacks against it. In addition, while you are within 60 feet of your companion, you can use a bonus action to switch places with it.

## Master Forgebound

_15th-level Forgebound feature_

Whenever your companion creates a weapon for you with Conjure Armament, it also creates a copy of the weapon for itself with the same infusion, and it is proficient with that weapon. In addition, whenever you cast an artificer spell that targets only you, your companion also gains the spell's benefits if it is within 60 feet of you.

_From user-provided Artificer specialization material._

entries.body:
# Grenadier

Grenadiers use their knowledge of alchemy to craft explosives for demolishing obstacles and overwhelming foes.

## Grenadier Features

| Artificer Level | Feature                                                    |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| 3rd             | Tools of the Trade, Grenadier Explosives, Grenadier Spells |
| 5th             | Extra Attack, Quick Chemistry                              |
| 10th            | Sabotage                                                   |
| 15th            | Arcane Trigger, Master Grenadier                           |

## Tools of the Trade

_3rd-level Grenadier feature_

You gain proficiency with alchemist's supplies. If you are already proficient with them, you instead gain proficiency with another type of artisan's tools of your choice.

## Grenadier Explosives

_3rd-level Grenadier feature_

You learn to craft two explosives: a Hand Bomb and one other explosive of your choice from the list below. You learn another Grenadier Explosive of your choice at 5th, 11th, and 17th level. Whenever you would learn a new infusion, you can instead learn a Grenadier Explosive.

**Crafting Explosives.** During a long rest, you can spend 1 hour using alchemist's supplies to craft one copy of each explosive you know. These Tiny objects lose their potency at the end of your next long rest. As an action, you can use your alchemist's supplies and expend the spell slot specified in an explosive's description to craft another copy. It also loses its potency at the end of your next long rest.

**Using Explosives.** A creature can take the Use an Object action to throw an explosive at a point it can see within 60 feet. It explodes on impact, producing the effects in its description, centered on the point of impact. Any saving throw against an explosive uses your spell save DC.

### Grenadier Explosives

If an explosive has an Artificer-level prerequisite, you can learn it when you reach that level.

#### 3rd-level explosives

**Glittering Dust** _(1st-level spell slot)._ On impact, reflective particles cover a 20-foot cube. Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature is covered in particles, and attack rolls against it have advantage. A creature can use its action to scrape off the particles, ending the effect.

**Hand Bomb** _(1st-level spell slot)._ Creatures within 5 feet of the impact must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Flammable objects in the area ignite. Damage increases to 4d6 at 5th level, 6d6 at 11th level, and 8d6 at 17th level.

**Seismic Charge** _(1st-level spell slot)._ Creatures within 10 feet must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 2d6 thunder damage and any Large or smaller creature falls prone. On a success, it takes half damage and doesn't fall prone. Nonmagical structures made of wood, earth, or stone take maximum damage. Loose dirt or stone in the area becomes difficult terrain; a creature can use its action to clear a 5-foot square. Damage increases to 4d6 at 5th level, 6d6 at 11th level, and 8d6 at 17th level.

**Tangleroot** _(1st-level spell slot)._ Synthetic vines burst on impact. Creatures within 5 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the vines for up to 1 minute. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC, ending the restraint on a success.

**Thunder Pulse** _(1st-level spell slot)._ A thunderous wave, audible out to 300 feet, bursts from the impact. Creatures in a 15-foot cube must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 2d6 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away; on a success, it takes half damage and isn't moved. Unsecured objects in the area are pushed 10 feet away. Damage increases to 4d6 at 5th level, 6d6 at 11th level, and 8d6 at 17th level.

#### 5th-level explosives

**Arcane Explosive** _(2nd-level spell slot)._ You infuse the explosive with a spell you know. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action, can't require concentration, and must force a saving throw.

**Alchemical Webbing** _(2nd-level spell slot)._ Sticky webbing covers a 20-foot cube, creating difficult terrain and lightly obscuring the area. If no vertical surfaces, walls, or ceilings support it, the webbing collapses and dissolves. A creature that starts its turn in the webbing or enters it during its turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be restrained. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC, ending the restraint on a success. The webbing lasts 1 minute and dissolves if it takes fire damage.

**Noxious Gas** _(2nd-level spell slot)._ A cloud of putrid yellow gas spreads in a 20-foot-radius sphere, spreads around corners, and heavily obscures the area for 1 minute. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or spend its turn gagging and reeling. A creature immune to poison or that doesn't need to breathe automatically succeeds.

#### 11th-level explosives

**Greater Seismic Charge** _(3rd-level spell slot)._ Creatures within 30 feet must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 6d6 thunder damage and any Huge or smaller creature falls prone. On a success, it takes half damage and doesn't fall prone. Nonmagical structures made of wood, earth, or stone take maximum damage. Loose dirt or stone in the area becomes difficult terrain; a creature can use its action to clear a 5-foot square. At 17th level, damage increases to 8d6.

**Vitriolic Charge** _(3rd-level spell slot)._ Creatures within 30 feet of the impact must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 6d6 acid damage and 3d6 acid damage at the start of its next turn. At 17th level, the initial damage increases to 8d6 and the follow-up damage to 5d6.

#### 17th-level explosive

**Astral Vortex** _(4th-level spell slot)._ A rift to the Astral Plane opens. Creatures within 5 feet must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sucked through the rift for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature can repeat the save, returning to its original space on a success. The rift then disappears.

## Grenadier Spells

_3rd-level Grenadier feature_

You always have the following spells prepared. They don't count against the number of spells you can prepare.

| Artificer Level | Spells                                 |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| 3rd             | _Caustic brew, earth tremor_           |
| 5th             | _[[Flaming Sphere]], [[Shatter]]_      |
| 9th             | _[[Fireball]], erupting earth_         |
| 13th            | _Sickening radiance, [[Wall of Fire]]_ |
| 17th            | _Immolation, maelstrom_                |

## Extra Attack

_5th-level Grenadier feature_

You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. Moreover, you can take the Use an Object action in place of one or both of these attacks.

## Quick Chemistry

_5th-level Grenadier feature_

As a bonus action on your turn, you can expend a spell slot to craft a Grenadier Explosive you know.

## Sabotage

_10th-level Grenadier feature_

Any creature that is surprised or hasn't acted during the first round of combat has disadvantage on its initial saving throw against any Grenadier Explosive you throw.

In addition, whenever you roll initiative, you can craft one Hand Bomb without expending a spell slot, or craft one other explosive you know, expending a spell slot as normal.

## Arcane Trigger

_15th-level Grenadier feature_

When you craft an explosive, you can incorporate a rudimentary arcane remote. As an action, you can trigger one explosive you crafted with a remote if you are within 200 feet of it.

## Master Grenadier

_15th-level Grenadier feature_

Your explosive throwing range increases to 120 feet. If you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can throw up to two explosives at two different targets within range or drop them at your feet. Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against these explosives. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

_From user-provided Artificer specialization material._

frontmatter.title: Lycanist
frontmatter.summary: Transforms into a customizable beast form

entries.body:
# Lycanist

Lycanists study the cursed science of werebeasts, transforming into a powerful amalgamation of beasts and choosing new traits with each transformation.

## Lycanist Features

| Artificer Level | Feature                                  |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| 3rd             | Tools of the Trade, Lycan Transformation |
| 5th             | Extra Attack                             |
| 10th            | Supernatural Resilience                  |
| 15th            | Master Lycanist                          |

## Tools of the Trade

_3rd-level Lycanist feature_

You gain proficiency with alchemist's supplies. If you are already proficient with them, you instead gain proficiency with another type of artisan's tools of your choice.

## Lycan Transformation

_3rd-level Lycanist feature_

As a bonus action, you can expend a spell slot to transform into your Lycan Form, using its stat block below. While transformed, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, your personality, alignment, and ability to speak. If both you and the form are proficient in the same skill, use whichever bonus is higher. Choose whether your equipment merges into the form, is worn or wielded by it, or falls to the ground.

When you transform, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Artificer level. You remain in this form for 1 hour, until you use a bonus action to revert, or until you are reduced to 0 hit points.

**Appearance.** You choose what type or combination of beasts your form resembles; this choice doesn't affect its abilities or statistics.

**Spellcasting.** You can't cast spells while in Lycan Form, but you can concentrate on spells you cast before transforming, such as _enlarge/reduce_.

**Bestial Traits.** When you transform, choose a number of Bestial Traits equal to 1 + the level of the spell slot expended. If a trait has a level prerequisite, you can choose it once you meet that prerequisite.

**Infusions.** If you are wearing or wielding armor or a weapon bearing an infusion, the Lycan Form's Armor Class (for armor) and Bite and Maul attacks (for weapons) gain the benefits of the respective infusions.

### Lycan Form

_Large beast (shapechanger)_

| Statistic      | Value                                                 |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| Armor Class    | 13 + your Intelligence modifier                       |
| Speed          | 40 ft.                                                |
| Senses         | Darkvision 120 ft.                                    |
| Bestial Traits | 1 + the level of the spell slot expended to transform |

**STR** 18 (+4), **DEX** 14 (+2), **CON** 16 (+3)

**Skills.** Athletics +4 + PB; Perception your Wisdom modifier + PB  
**Primal Fury.** When the form makes an ability check or saving throw using Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution, you can add your PB to the roll.

#### Actions

**Bite.** _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 + PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 1d8 + 4 piercing damage.

**Maul.** _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 + PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 2d6 + 4 slashing damage.

## Bestial Traits

When a trait requires a saving throw, it uses your artificer spell save DC.

### Traits without a level prerequisite

- **Aggressive.** As a bonus action, your Lycan Form can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see, hear, or smell.
- **Amphibious.** Your Lycan Form gains a swimming speed equal to its walking speed and can breathe air and water.
- **Charge.** When your Lycan Form moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and hits it with Maul, it deals an extra 1d6 damage. A creature no larger than your form must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall prone.
- **Keen Senses.** Your Lycan Form has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
- **Light Step.** Your Lycan Form has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while lightly obscured by natural foliage or weather.
- **Mimicry.** Your Lycan Form can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person's voice or animal calls. A creature can identify the sounds as imitations by using its action to succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.
- **Nimble.** Your Lycan Form doubles its proficiency bonus for Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
- **Opportunist.** When your Lycan Form hits a prone target with Bite, it rolls one additional damage die.
- **Opposable Thumbs.** Your Lycan Form can manipulate objects and tools as well as a commoner, but can't use weapons or complex tools.
- **Powerful Build.** Your Lycan Form counts as one size larger when determining the creatures it can grapple and the weight it can move or lift.
- **Prehensile Tail.** Your Lycan Form's tail can hold Tiny objects and grasp surfaces while climbing.
- **Reflexive Fall.** When your Lycan Form falls, it can use its reaction to reduce falling damage by its Dexterity score. If the damage is reduced to 0, it lands on its feet.
- **Savage Grip.** Your Lycan Form gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed and can climb sheer surfaces and ceilings without an ability check. It has advantage on saving throws to resist being moved against its will, grappled, restrained, or knocked prone.
- **Standing Leap.** Your Lycan Form's long jump is at least 15 feet and its high jump at least 10 feet, even without a running start.
- **Vicious Bite.** When your Lycan Form hits a creature no larger than itself with Bite, it can grapple the target. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and your form can't Bite another target.

### Traits requiring 5th level

- **Thermal Vision.** Your Lycan Form knows the exact location of warm-blooded creatures within 30 feet.
- **Concussive Strike.** Once per turn when your Lycan Form hits a creature with Maul, it can force it to make a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn. A creature larger than your form has advantage on this save.
- **Echolocation.** Your Lycan Form gains blindsight out to 30 feet. When it makes a Wisdom (Perception) check based on hearing, it can treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8. It loses this benefit and its blindsight while deafened.
- **Pack Tactics.** Your Lycan Form has advantage on attack rolls against a target if one of its conscious allies is within 5 feet of it.
- **Relentless.** When your Lycan Form would be reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can expend one of your Hit Dice to fall to 1 hit point instead.
- **Thick Hide.** Whenever your Lycan Form takes damage, reduce it by your Constitution modifier. Force and psychic damage ignore this reduction.
- **Venomous (3/Day).** When your Lycan Form hits a creature with Bite, it can force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 1d4 poison damage and is poisoned. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success or taking 1d4 poison damage on a failure.

## Extra Attack

_5th-level Lycanist feature_

You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. Also, when you use your action to cast a spell, you can make a melee attack as a bonus action. Your attacks in Lycan Form count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

## Supernatural Resilience

_10th-level Lycanist feature_

While in Lycan Form, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from non-silvered weapons.

## Master Lycanist

_15th-level Lycanist feature_

You can cast spells normally while in Lycan Form. Moreover, whenever you take the Attack action in that form, you can make three attacks instead of two.

_From user-provided Artificer specialization material._

frontmatter.title: Ooze Rancher
frontmatter.summary: Raises a domesticated ooze and adapts it with harvested creature essences

entries.body:
# Ooze Rancher

Ooze Ranchers use an Ooze Containment Unit to raise a loyal ooze and harvest creature essences that grant it new abilities.

## Ooze Rancher Features

| Artificer Level | Feature                                                                          |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 3rd             | Domesticated Ooze, Ooze Containment Unit, Ooze Rancher Spells, Essence Harvester |
| 5th             | Extra Attack                                                                     |
| 9th             | Ooze Adept                                                                       |
| 15th            | Master Rancher                                                                   |

## Domesticated Ooze

_3rd-level Ooze Rancher feature_

You have captured, bred, or created a Domesticated Ooze to serve you. Its stat block appears below and uses your proficiency bonus (PB) and spell save DC. It is friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands.

In combat, it acts on your turn. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but takes only the Dodge action unless you use a bonus action to order it to take an action from its stat block or another action. Whenever you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your attacks to order your Ooze to attack. If you are incapacitated, it acts on its own to defend itself and you to the best of its ability.

### Domesticated Ooze

_Tiny ooze, neutral_

| Statistic            | Value                                                                   |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Armor Class          | 8 + PB (natural armor)                                                  |
| Hit Points           | 5 + five times your Artificer level                                     |
| Speed                | 20 ft., climb 30 ft.                                                    |
| Damage Resistances   | Acid, poison                                                            |
| Condition Immunities | Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone               |
| Senses               | Blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius); passive Perception 8 + PB |
| Languages            | Understands the languages you speak                                     |

**STR** 14 (+2), **DEX** 6 (−2), **CON** 16 (+3), **INT** 1 (−5), **WIS** 6 (−2), **CHA** 1 (−4)

**Amorphous.** The Ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.  
**Might of the Master.** Add your PB to any ability check or saving throw the Ooze makes.

#### Actions

**Slam.** _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +2 + PB to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 1d8 + PB acid damage.

## Ooze Containment Unit

_3rd-level Ooze Rancher feature_

You create a Small item that creates and holds your Domesticated Ooze. It can be worn as a backpack or carried with two hands.

While wearing the Unit and with your Ooze within 10 feet, you can use a bonus action to store it in the Unit or eject it into an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet. While stored, the Ooze can't take damage or be targeted. The Unit can hold only one Ooze at a time.

If your Ooze is killed, you can use your action and expend a 1st-level or higher spell slot to create another Ooze inside the Unit. At the end of each long rest, you can create a new Ooze in the Unit without expending a spell slot. You can have only one Ooze at a time; creating a new one causes any previous Ooze to dissolve into goo. If your Unit is destroyed, you can craft another from spare parts over the course of a long rest.

## Ooze Rancher Spells

_3rd-level Ooze Rancher feature_

You always have the following spells prepared. They don't count against the number of spells you can prepare.

| Artificer Level | Spells                                             |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| 3rd             | _Caustic brew, [[Inflict Wounds]]_                 |
| 5th             | _[[Acid Arrow]], [[spells/2nd-level/Enlarge-Reduce | Enlarge/Reduce]]_ |
| 9th             | _Corrosive bolt, [[Slow]]_                         |
| 13th            | _[[Freedom of Movement]], vitriolic sphere_        |
| 17th            | _[[Contagion]], [[Reincarnate]]_                   |

## Essence Harvester

_3rd-level Ooze Rancher feature_

As an action, touch your Ooze Containment Unit to a creature that has died within the last minute and harvest its Essence. The Unit can hold a number of Essences equal to your Artificer level. If you harvest one while at your maximum, choose one Essence to replace.

While your Ooze is inside the Unit, you can use an action to infuse it with an Essence, granting the benefits described below. An Essence is expended when infused. Your Ooze can benefit from one Essence at a time. It can benefit from more at once as you gain levels: two at 5th level, three at 9th level, and four at 15th level.

## Extra Attack

_5th-level Ooze Rancher feature_

You can attack twice, rather than once, when you take the Attack action on your turn. Moreover, once per turn when you order your Ooze to attack, it can make two attacks.

## Ooze Adept

_9th-level Ooze Rancher feature_

You gain resistance to acid and poison damage. In addition, when you infuse your Ooze with an Essence, the Essence is no longer expended.

## Master Rancher

_15th-level Ooze Rancher feature_

Whenever you use your Ooze Containment Unit to create an Ooze, choose whether it is Small, Medium, or Large.

## Creature Essences

These features apply to your Domesticated Ooze when you infuse it with the corresponding Essence.

- **Aberrant Essence.** The Ooze gains resistance to psychic damage. When it hits a creature with Slam, that target has disadvantage on the first Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma check or saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn. Its Slam can deal psychic damage instead.
- **Bestial Essence.** The Ooze's speed increases by 10 feet, and it gains a climbing or swimming speed (your choice) equal to its walking speed. It adds your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) to Wisdom (Perception) checks. Its appearance becomes primal and wild.
- **Celestial Essence.** The Ooze gains resistance to necrotic and radiant damage and a flying speed equal to its walking speed. As an action, it can grant a creature it touches temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier. Its Slam can deal fire or radiant damage instead.
- **Draconic Essence.** The Ooze gains resistance to cold, fire, poison, lightning, or thunder damage (your choice) and a flying speed equal to its walking speed. When you order it to make a Slam attack, it can make one additional Slam attack. Its Slam can deal the type of damage to which it has resistance instead.
- **Elemental Essence.** The Ooze gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and to cold, fire, or lightning damage (choose one of these types). It can replace a Slam attack with a burst of elemental energy. Creatures within 10 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw; on a failure, they take damage of the chosen type equal to the damage of its Slam attack.
- **Faerie Essence.** The Ooze gains resistance to psychic damage and immunity to the charmed condition. After it makes a Slam attack, it can teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. Its Slam can deal poison or psychic damage instead.
- **Fiendish Essence.** The Ooze gains resistance to fire and necrotic damage. When you command it to make a Slam attack, it makes one additional Slam attack. A creature it hits can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. Its Slam can deal poison or fire damage instead.
- **Monstrous Essence.** The Ooze's size increases by one category and its speed increases by 10 feet. Its Slam can deal slashing damage instead.
- **Titanic Essence.** The Ooze's size increases by one category, it gains bonus hit points equal to twice your Artificer level, and it has advantage on Strength checks and saving throws. Its Slam can deal bludgeoning damage instead.
- **Verdant Essence.** The Ooze takes on a plantlike appearance, is immune to the poisoned condition, and can't be moved against its will. It gains temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) at the start of each of its turns. Its Slam can deal poison or slashing damage instead.
- **Undying Essence.** The Ooze gains immunity to necrotic and poison damage and to the poisoned condition. Its Slam can deal necrotic damage instead; when it does, the Ooze gains temporary hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

_From user-provided Artificer specialization material._

frontmatter.title: Static Conductor
frontmatter.summary: Channels lightning through a specialized suit

entries.body:
# Static Conductor

Static Conductors harness lightning and store its power in a signature suit, using it to protect allies, stun foes, and move with startling speed.

## Static Conductor Features

| Artificer Level | Feature                                           |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| 3rd             | Tools of the Trade, Static Suit, Conductor Spells |
| 5th             | Channel Lightning, Extra Attack                   |
| 10th            | Improved Efficiency                               |
| 15th            | Master Lightningrod                               |

## Tools of the Trade

_3rd-level Static Conductor feature_

You gain proficiency with smith's tools. If you are already proficient with them, you instead gain proficiency with another type of artisan's tools of your choice.

## Static Suit

_3rd-level Static Conductor feature_

During a long rest, you can spend 1 hour using smith's tools to modify one set of light or medium armor you touch, transforming it into a Static Suit. You can have only one suit at a time, and only you can use it. Crafting another causes the previous suit to lose its power.

While wearing the suit, you have resistance to lightning damage and can use it as a spellcasting focus for your artificer spells.

**Lightning Rod.** When you take lightning damage while wearing the suit, you can use your reaction to gain temporary hit points equal to the lightning damage you would have taken after resistance, instead of taking the damage. Whenever you expend a 1st-level or higher spell slot to cast a spell that deals lightning damage, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice the slot's level.

**Electrical Jolt.** While wearing the suit, you know _shocking grasp_ and _spare the dying_. They count as artificer spells for you. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 lightning damage on a hit, and you can use Strength or Intelligence for their attack and damage rolls. The damage increases to 1d8 at 10th level and 1d10 at 15th level.

**Infusions.** Your Static Suit can bear one infusion meant for a suit of armor, a spellcasting focus, or a metal rod.

## Conductor Spells

_3rd-level Static Conductor feature_

You always have the following spells prepared. They don't count against the number of spells you can prepare.

| Artificer Level | Spells                                  |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| 3rd             | _Thunderous smite, witch bolt_          |
| 5th             | _[[Misty Step]], [[Shatter]]_           |
| 9th             | _[[Lightning Bolt]], thunder step_      |
| 13th            | _[[Freedom of Movement]], storm sphere_ |
| 17th            | _Far step, steel wind strike_           |

## Channel Lightning

_5th-level Static Conductor feature_

While you have temporary hit points from Lightning Rod, you can expend those temporary hit points to use the following features:

- **Quick Step.** Expend 1 temporary hit point to take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action on your turn.
- **Tasing Touch.** When you hit a target with a weapon attack, expend 3 temporary hit points to force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, its speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.

## Extra Attack

_5th-level Static Conductor feature_

You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action. Also, whenever you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

## Improved Efficiency

_10th-level Static Conductor feature_

Your Channel Lightning features improve:

- **Quick Step.** You gain the benefits of both Dash and Disengage whenever you use this feature.
- **Tasing Touch.** On a failed save, the target is also stunned until the start of your next turn.

## Master Lightningrod

_15th-level Static Conductor feature_

While you have temporary hit points from Lightning Rod, your speed increases by 10 feet and you gain one additional reaction each round. You can use only one reaction per turn.

_From user-provided Artificer specialization material._
