| 5th        | impairing strike    |
| 9th        | aura sight          |

### Entropic Touch

**3rd-level Way of the Void feature**

You can channel the entropic power of the Void to annihilate pieces of reality. As an action, you can spend 2 Ki and touch a Small or smaller non-magical object that is not being worn or carried, and instantly reduce it to a pile of fine grey dust.

As you reach certain Monk levels, you gain the ability to channel even more of this entropic power to unmake larger objects, spending more Ki, as shown on the table below:

| Monk Level | Ki Cost | Maximum Object Size |
| ---------- | ------- | ------------------- |
| 3rd        | 2       | Small               |
| 6th        | 4       | Medium              |
| 10th       | 6       | Large               |
| 17th       | 8       | Huge                |
| 20th       | 12      | Gargantuan          |

### Void Strike

**3rd-level Way of the Void feature**

You wield the entropic power of the Void as other warriors wield weapons. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can expend 1 Ki to deal bonus force damage equal to your Martial Arts Die, and until the start of your next turn, that creature cannot regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

If the target of this attack is concentrating on a spell, it has disadvantage on its saving throw to maintain concentration.

### Vorpal Step

**6th-level Way of the Void feature**

You can draw upon the energies of the Void to discorporate. When you use step of the wind, you can move through solid non-magical objects and creatures as difficult terrain.

However, if you stop this special movement while you are inside a solid object or creature, you are instantly shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take 1d10 force damage for every 5 feet you are forced to move to do so.

### Unmake Magic

**10th-level Way of the Void feature**

The entropic power of your spirit allows you to disrupt and destroy magic. You can spend 3 Ki to cast [[Counterspell]] or [[Dispel Magic]] at 3rd level. When you do so, Wisdom is considered your spellcasting ability for these spells.

### Master of Entropy

**17th-level Way of the Void feature**

Your power is annihilation itself. Once on each of your turns, you can forgo one unarmed strike to instead touch a creature and force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your Technique save DC. On a failed save, it suffers the effects of [[Disintegrate]] cast at 6th level.

You can use this feature once per long rest at no cost, after which, you must spend 6 Ki to use this feature again.

entries.title: Way of the Wu Jen
entries.summary: Monastic Tradition for the Monk

frontmatter.title: Way of the Wu Jen
frontmatter.summary: Monastic Tradition for the Monk

entries.body:
# Way of the Wu Jen

Rather than focus inward, some Monks attune themselves to the forces of nature. Known as Wu Jens, these primal sages augment their skills with the power of the five elements; Air, Earth, Fire, Water, and Wood. Through meditation, they can learn to manifest their Ki in displays of elemental power.

## Disciple of the Elements

**3rd-level Way of the Wu Jen feature**

You use ancient monastic arts that allow you to manipulate the forces of nature to cast spells using the rules below:

**Cantrips.** You learn two Cantrips of your choice from the Wu Jen spell list below. You learn one additional Wu Jen Cantrip at 10th and 17th level.

**Spell Slots.** The Wu Jen Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have, and the level of those slots. All of your spell slots are the same level. To cast a Wu Jen spell of 1st-level or higher, you must expend a spell slot. You use the spell's casting time and other rules, but your body becomes the spellcasting focus for these spells, and you don't need to provide any material components. You regain all expended Wu Jen spell slots when you finish a short or long rest.

**Spells Known of 1st-Level and Higher.** You learn two 1st-level spells of your choice from the Wu Jen spell list below. The Spells Known column of the Wu Jen Spellcasting table shows when you learn more Wu Jen spells. A spell you choose must be of a level no higher than what's shown in the table's Slot Level column for your level.

When you gain a level, you can replace one Wu Jen spell you know with another equal to your Slot level or lower.

**Spellcasting Ability.** Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your Wu Jen spells, so you use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability, when setting a saving throw DC, and when making a spell attack roll.

Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier

Spell attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier

### Wu Jen Spellcasting

| Monk Level | Spells Known | Spell Slots | Slot Level |
| ---------- | ------------ | ----------- | ---------- |
| 3rd        | 2            | 1           | 1st        |
| 4th        | 2            | 2           | 1st        |
| 5th        | 3            | 2           | 1st        |
| 6th        | 3            | 2           | 1st        |
| 7th        | 4            | 2           | 2nd        |
| 8th        | 4            | 2           | 2nd        |
| 9th        | 5            | 2           | 2nd        |
| 10th       | 5            | 2           | 2nd        |
| 11th       | 5            | 2           | 2nd        |
| 12th       | 5            | 2           | 2nd        |
| 13th       | 6            | 2           | 3rd        |
| 14th       | 6            | 2           | 3rd        |
| 15th       | 6            | 2           | 3rd        |
| 16th       | 6            | 2           | 3rd        |
| 17th       | 7            | 2           | 3rd        |
| 18th       | 7            | 2           | 3rd        |
| 19th       | 7            | 2           | 4th        |
| 20th       | 7            | 2           | 4th        |

### Wu Jen Spell List

The spells in the Wu Jen spell list are from the Player's Handbook, Xanathar's Guide to Everything (*), and Tasha's Cauldron of Everything (**).

Spells marked (LL) are found in the laserllama Spell Compendium, which includes both new and alternate spells.

The archive catalogue below contains spells with spell pages. Remaining options are preserved in the collapsed list.

![[wu-jen-spells.base]]

> [!info]- Options without archive spell pages
> These options remain part of the spell list but do not yet have spell pages in the archive.
> **Cantrips (0-Level):** Beckon Air (ll), Blade Ward, Control Flame (ll), Create Bonfire (_), Frostbite, Magic Stone (_), Mold Earth (ll), Shape Water (ll), Thorn Whip, Thunderclap (_)
> **1st-Level:** Absorb Elements (_), Armor of Agathys, Create Water (ll), Earth Tremor (_), Ensnaring Strike (ll), Hail of Thorns (ll), Ice Knife (_), Witch Bolt (ll)
> **2nd-Level:** Dust Devil (_), Earthbind (_), Earthen Grasp (_), Snowball Swarm (_), Warding Wind (_)
> **3rd-Level:** Erupting Earth (_), Grasping Vine (ll), Minute Meteors (_), Thunder Step (_), Tidal Wave (_), Wall of Sand (_), Wall of Water (_)
> **4th-Level:** Elemental Bane (_), Guardian of Nature (Tree) (_), Pillars of Earth (ll), Storm Sphere (_), Watery Sphere (*)

### Fist of the Five Ways

**3rd-level Way of the Wu Jen feature**

You can infuse your fists with the power of the five elements. Whenever you make an unarmed strike, you can change its damage to the type dealt by one Wu Jen spell you know.

When you do, the reach of that unarmed strike increases by 5 feet, as it is wreathed in the power of that element.

### Elemental Spirit

**6th-level Way of the Wu Jen feature**

Your spirit is a conduit for your elemental magic. As a bonus action on your turn, you can expend Ki equal to 1 + your Slot Level to regain one expended Wu Jen spell slot.

Moreover, when you use your action to cast a Wu Jen spell, you can make one unarmed strike attack as a bonus action.

### Spiritual Flow

**10th-level Way of the Wu Jen feature**

You weave your martial arts with spiritual magic. When you cast a Wu Jen spell with a casting time of 1 action, you can expend 2 Ki to cast it as a bonus action instead.

### Master of the Elements

**17th-level Way of the Wu Jen feature**

As an action, you can draw all five elements into yourself to take on an Elemental Form, gaining the following benefits:

You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Critical hits against you become normal hits. Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage. You can gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1) at the start of each of your turns. Your Elemental Form lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if you are Incapacitated or use a bonus action to end it. You can use this feature once per long rest at no cost, after that, you must expend 6 Ki to transform again.

entries.body:
# Oath of the Ancients

Often called green knights, these paladins guard life and natural beauty. **Tenets:** Beauty—protect natural beauty and innocent life; Hope—kindle hope and never give in to despair; Light—delight in song, dance, and laughter, and spread joy.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                      |
| ------------- | -------------------------------- |
| 3rd           | absorb elements*, entangle       |
| 5th           | moonbeam, spike growth           |
| 9th           | grasping vine ll, plant growth   |
| 13th          | guardian of nature*, ice storm   |
| 17th          | commune with nature, tree stride |

**Elder Shield (3rd, Channel Divinity, 2 Resolve).** As a reaction when you or a creature within 10 feet takes cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder damage, reduce it by your Paladin level + Charisma modifier. At 6th level, this can protect any creature under your Aura of Protection.

**Verdant Smite (3rd, Oath Smite, bludgeoning).** The target makes a Dexterity save; on a failure, vines entangle it and its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

**Aura of the Elder Ward (7th).** Creatures under your Aura of Protection have resistance to damage from spells.

**Undying Sentinel (15th).** You age 1 year for every 10 that pass, and magic can't age you. Once per long rest, when you start your turn at 0 hit points and aren't dead, you stand with 1 hit point.

**Avatar of the Ancients (20th).** For 10 minutes, regain 10 hit points at the start of each turn, and your aura is difficult terrain for creatures you choose. Other Avatar terms apply.

# Oath of Beauty

Paladins of Beauty strive for excellence and a gleaming presence, inspiring the downtrodden or manipulating those they consider beneath them. **Tenets:** Grace—act with quiet dignity; Perfection—improve combat skill and social standing; Reputation—uphold the highest social standard.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                   |

| 3rd           | charm person, disguise self   |
| 5th           | enthrall, suggestion          |
| 9th           | fear, hypnotic pattern        |
| 13th          | charm monster XGE, compulsion |
| 17th          | dominate person, seeming      |

**Otherworldly Elegance (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As an action, touch your holy symbol to enhance your appearance with divine glamour for 1 hour. Treat a 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10 on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

**Quell the Defiler (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** When a creature you see within 30 feet attacks you, use a reaction to force a Wisdom save. On failure, its attack misses and it is charmed by you until the end of your next turn or until you attack it.

**Aura of Elegance (7th).** Creatures you choose in your aura have disadvantage on saves against your illusion or enchantment spells. You have advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks against creatures in the aura while not fighting them.

**Beauty Revealed (15th).** When hit by an attack, use a reaction to add Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to AC against it. Uses per long rest equal Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

**Paragon of Beauty (20th).** As a bonus action, reveal your divine beauty for 1 minute: immune to charmed; weapon hits deal extra damage equal to Charisma modifier; cast charm person as a 1st-level spell as a bonus action each turn, including this turn, without a slot.

Charisma save or obey you for 1 hour or until you use this again; it repeats the save each time it takes damage from you or allies.

# Oath of the Blade

Blade Masters dedicate their lives to martial mastery. **Tenets:** Fair Play—level the field for a fair fight; Respect—respect every fellow warrior, even a bitter foe.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

**Sacred Duel (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As a bonus action, begin a 1-minute duel with a willing creature within 30 feet, ending if either duelist becomes unconscious. Duelists resist all damage from others, and can target only each other with attacks, spells, and features.

**Blade Paths (3rd).** Learn one additional Smite Path. Your 11th-level Second Smite Path feature grants a third path.

**Honed Edge (7th).** When rolling a smite's extra damage dice, reroll any 1s or 2s once and use the new rolls.

**Skillful Counter (15th).** When a creature you see hits you with a melee attack, use a reaction to make one melee attack against it with advantage. On a hit, you can expend a spell slot to smite it.

**Warrior of Legend (20th).** As a bonus action, enter a 1-minute battle trance, ending if incapacitated. Once on each of your turns when you hit with a melee weapon attack, use a smite you know whose lowest slot is 4th level or lower without a slot, treating it as a 5th-level slot.

# Oath of Conquest

Conquerors seek glory through domination, crushing foes in body and spirit and upholding law through iron justice. **Tenets:** Conquest—crush foes so they never oppose you again; Iron Law—your word is law, reward loyalty and punish dissent; Might—might makes right, and you are mighty.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| 5th           | hold person, find steed ll       |
| 9th           | bestow curse, fear               |
| 13th          | dominate creature ll, compulsion |
| 17th          | dominate person, vorpal blade ll |

**Conquering Smite (3rd, Oath Smite, psychic).** Wisdom save or frightened of you until the end of its next turn.

**Lethal Strike (3rd, Channel Divinity, 2 Resolve).** Once per turn before you know whether a weapon attack hits, add twice your Charisma modifier to its attack roll.

**Aura of Dominion (7th).** Creatures you choose in your aura treat the area as difficult terrain. A creature frightened of you has its speed halved while in the aura. Total cover blocks this effect.

**Ruthless Reprisal (15th).** When a creature in your aura damages you or forces a save, it takes damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), of a type you could choose for Righteous Strikes.

**Avatar of Conquest (20th).** Gain resistance to all damage. At the start of each turn, one creature in your aura must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened of you until the start of your next turn. Whenever you take the Attack action, make one additional weapon attack as part of it.

# Oath of Devotion

White knights stand as paragons of virtue, justice, and honor. **Tenets:** Compassion—protect the vulnerable and temper mercy with caution; Honesty—don't deceive for your own benefit and keep your word; Honor—do the most good with the least harm and obey rightful authority.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

**Consecrated Smite (3rd, Oath Smite, radiant).** Wisdom save or, until the end of its next turn, the target can't willingly move closer to you or take reactions. Fiends and undead have disadvantage on the save.

# Oath of Glory

You strive to become a legendary hero through mighty deeds and deadly challenges. **Tenets:** Glory—be known for deeds, not words; Might—seek physical, spiritual, and mental perfection; Tenacity—meet worthy adversity without fleeing.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

entries.title: Paladin Subclasses
entries.body:
# Paladin Subclasses

**24 Sacred Oaths available** | Choose at 3rd level | Features at 3rd, 7th, 15th, and 20th level

## Sacred Oath Rules

Oath spells are Paladin spells for you, don't count against your Spells Known, and can't be replaced. Resolve features are Channel Divinity options with their listed costs and have no other limit. Oaths refer to creature types or their own Tenets, never alignment. For Oath Smite scaling, marked dice, rider limits, and Avatar transformation rules, see the [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#sacred-oath-rules|shared Sacred Oath rules]].

### Oath Smites

An Oath Smite belongs to no Smite Path and has no prerequisite. When you hit with a melee weapon attack or an unarmed strike, you can expend a spell slot to use it, in place of a path smite; you can use only one smite per hit, and the spell slot is its only cost.

An Oath Smite deals 2d6* damage of its listed type for a 1st-level slot, plus 1d6* for each slot level above 1st, to a maximum of 6d6*. A marked die increases one size at Paladin 9th level (d6 to d8, or d8 to d10). Selfish Smite grants temporary hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. Glorious Smite instead grants temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier plus twice the slot level, as its feature specifies.

Its rider is one effect, either instantaneous or ending by the end of the target's next turn. A rider is comparable in strength to a tier-1 path rider such as [[character-options/class-options/smite-paths/Frost#chilling-smite|Chilling Smite]], [[character-options/class-options/smite-paths/Storm#thundering-smite|Thundering Smite]], or [[character-options/class-options/smite-paths/Venom#sickening-smite|Sickening Smite]], and doesn't scale with slot level. Saving throw DCs equal your spell save DC. No Oath Smite rider lasts longer than 1 minute or takes a creature's turn. See this catalogue's [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]] for transformation duration and repeat-use rules.

### Avatar Terms

An Avatar feature lasts 1 minute unless that feature says otherwise. It ends early if you become unconscious or use a bonus action to end it. You can transform once per long rest without a spell slot; each additional transformation before your next long rest requires expending a 5th-level spell slot. An oath capstone's own duration or ending conditions override these default terms where they differ.

### Spell source marks

`ll` identifies a laserllama Spell Compendium version, as described in the archive's Warden spell list. Those alternate versions are not included here, so their levels cannot be verified from the archive. The standard versions of Grasping Vine and Elemental Bane are 4th-level spells, Locate Creature is 4th level, Create Undead is 6th level, and Dominate Creature is 8th level. The `ll` variants may differ; confirm their actual levels in the compendium before using these lists with the Paladin slot progression. This matters for the listed unlocks: Grasping Vine and Elemental Bane at 9th-level Paladin, Locate Creature at 5th, Dominate Creature at 13th, and Create Undead at 13th.

# Oath of Inquisition

Inquisitors reveal what is hidden and punish those who deceive mortals by obscuring their true form. **Tenets:** Truth—bring truth to light; Immutability—distrust those who alter or hide their form; Retribution—fit punishment to the crime.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                   |

| 5th           | moonbeam, zone of truth       |
| 9th           | clairvoyance, magic circle    |
| 13th          | arcane eye, charm monster XGE |
| 17th          | legend lore, scrying          |

**Divine Interrogation (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As an action, choose a creature within 10 feet that can see or hear you. Charisma save or you learn its true name, and it has disadvantage on the first Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save you force it to make within 1 minute.

**Surprise Inquisition (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** When rolling initiative, if not surprised or incapacitated, use a reaction to choose up to three creatures that can see, hear, and understand you. Wisdom save or disadvantage on attack rolls and no reactions until the end of its first turn in the encounter.

**Aura of Truth (7th).** Creatures you choose in your aura have disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks and advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks; choose which effects apply.

**Iron Will (15th).** Immune to charmed and enchantment spell effects.

**Grand Inquisitor (20th).** As a bonus action, transform for 1 minute: gain truesight to 120 feet; instantly know if a creature is lying to you; a shapechanger hit by your attack reverts to its original form and takes 2d8 extra radiant damage.

# Oath of Liberty

Liberty paladins stand with the oppressed against tyranny and seek justice fairly applied. **Tenets:** Equality—treat all equally; Equity—ensure access to basic needs; Freedom—free the oppressed and bring justice to oppressors.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                             |

| 3rd           | heroism, shield of faith                |
| 5th           | prayer of healing, warding bond         |
| 9th           | life transference XGE, revivify         |
| 13th          | aura of purity, freedom of movement     |
| 17th          | mass cure wounds, skill empowerment XGE |

**Admonish the Tyrannical (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** When a creature you see within 30 feet damages another creature, use a reaction to rebuke it. For 1 minute or until concentration ends, it has disadvantage on attacks that don't target you.

**Shield the Meek (3rd, Channel Divinity, 2 Resolve).** When a creature you see within 30 feet is hit, use a reaction to add Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to its AC against the attack.

**Aura of Solidarity (7th).** When an ally in your aura takes damage, reduce it by Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

**Liberator (15th).** As a bonus action on each turn, let one creature in your aura repeat a save to end one hostile effect affecting it.

**Shield of Freedom (20th).** As a bonus action, transform for 1 minute: gain flying speed equal to walking speed; once per turn when damaging a creature, choose another creature in your aura to regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt; use Shield the Meek as a reaction each turn without Resolve.

frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of Mysticism

Mystics awaken their own inner psionic power. Optional rule: use Intelligence instead of Charisma for all Paladin features. **Tenets:** Asceticism—forsake attachments; Enlightenment—realize potential and help others; Knowledge—seek deeper enlightenment through knowledge.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                      |
| ------------- | -------------------------------- |
| 3rd           | catapult XGE, dissonant whispers |
| 5th           | detect thoughts, levitate        |
| 9th           | clairvoyance, slow               |
| 13th          | confusion, phantasmal killer     |
| 17th          | telekinesis, wall of force       |

**Enlightened Spell (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** When casting a Mysticism spell, grasp your holy symbol to cast without verbal or somatic components.

**Psionic Smite (3rd, Oath Smite, psychic).** Wisdom save or target's speed is halved until its next turn ends.

**Aura of Enlightenment (7th).** Creatures you choose in your aura resist force and psychic damage and have advantage on saves against charmed or frightened.

**Psionic Rebuke (15th).** When a creature in your aura hits you while you aren't incapacitated, it takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

**Mystic Ascension (20th).** As a bonus action, become luminous for 1 minute: emit bright light in 5 feet and dim light 5 feet farther; gain flying speed equal to walking speed; become immune to psychic and resistant to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing; move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain, taking 1d10 force damage per 5 feet if shunted after ending inside one.

entries.title: Oath of Righteousness
entries.summary: Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of Righteousness
frontmatter.summary: Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
The Oath of Righteousness binds a paladin to honor, justice, order, and all other concepts encompassed by righteousness. They pursue the greater good. They are knights who help those in need and the enemies of all that is dishonorable. They worship the good gods of honor, justice, and law. They have no fear in the face of injustice, even if that means they have to fight the entire world.

## Tenets of Righteousness

Paladins that take the Oath of Righteousness may follow different ideals, but they all share the following tenets.

**Passion.** Never let your enemies take away your zeal. Always go after what you think is right.

**Patience.** Don't act in anger. Think before you act.

**Truth.** Always seek the truth, even if it is to your detriment.

## Oath of Righteousness spells

You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

| Paladin level | Spells                                 |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| 3rd           | [[Command]], compelled duel            |
| 5th           | [[Warding Bond]], [[Zone of Truth]]    |
| 9th           | [[Dispel Magic]], [[Tongues]]          |
| 13th          | [[Banishment]], [[Enhance Perception]] |
| 17th          | [[Geas]], [[Sinner's Mark]]            |

## Features

> [!info]- Channel Divinity (level 3)
> When you take this oath at 3rd level, you gain the following two Channel Divinity options.
>
> **Ally of the Righteous.** As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer. A number of allies of your choice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one ally) within 30 feet of you regains 1d8 hit points.
>
> When you reach 10th level in this class, the amount of hit points regained in this way increases to 2d8.
>
> **Righteous Fire.** As an action, you can imbue a number of weapons up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one weapon) that you or your allies within 30 feet of you are wielding, with the fire of righteousness. Until the end of your and your allies' next turn, these weapons deal an extra 1d4 fire damage on a hit.
>
> When you reach 10th level in this class, the extra fire damage increases to 1d8.

> [!info]- Aura of the Righteous (level 7)
> Starting at 7th level, you and your allies within 10 feet of you deal extra fire or radiant damage (one of your choice) equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one damage) on successful weapon attacks, and have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

> [!info]- Enemy of All Dishonorable (level 15)
> Beginning at 15th level, you have a +2 bonus to your weapon attack rolls.
>
> You can also use an action to make a single weapon attack using this feature, forfeiting the additional attacks you can make with a bonus action and the Extra Attack feature. When you do so, you cannot have disadvantage on the attack roll, and on a hit, the target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

> [!info]- Might of the Righteous (level 20)
> At 20th level, you can cast the might of the divine ruler (p. 178) spell without expending a spell slot and requiring no spell components.
>
> You always have this spell prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. Also, each time you cast this spell, you regain 20 hit points.
>
> Once you use this feature, you must finish a long rest to use it again.

_From Corpus Angelus._

entries.title: Oath of the Exorcist
entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of the Exorcist
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of the Exorcist

Exorcists hunt the undead and protect the living, sacrificing ordinary lives to defend the world. **Tenets:** Defend—protect life, especially the innocent; Destroy—hunt and destroy undead; Focus—bear no titles, lands, family, or children.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                              |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| 3rd           | protection from evil and good, sanctuary |
| 5th           | invisibility, see invisibility           |
| 9th           | magic circle, spirit guardians           |
| 13th          | banishment, greater invisibility         |
| 17th          | dispel evil and good, holy weapon XGE    |

**Sinister Insights (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As an action, grasp your holy symbol to gain advantage for 1 hour on ability checks and saving throws related to undead or necromancy magic.

**Warrior of the Dawn (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As a bonus action, choose a creature within 30 feet. For 1 minute, each time you deal damage to it, deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage.

**Spectral Form (7th).** As a bonus action, become spectral until the end of your turn: resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical or non-silvered attacks; move through objects and creatures as difficult terrain. If you end inside one, you are shunted to the nearest free space and take 1d10 force damage per 5 feet traveled. Once per short or long rest; when out of uses, expend a 2nd-level or higher slot to use it again. At 18th level, use each turn without a resource.

**Scouring Strike (15th).** When you deal radiant damage to a creature, it can't regain hit points or become incorporeal until your next turn starts.

**Sacrificial Offering (20th).** When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, spend one Hit Die to drop to 1 hit point instead.

frontmatter.title: The Oathless
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# The Oathless

Oathless paladins broke their oath for reasons other than evil but retain some power. They owe allegiance to none; their safety and power come first.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oathless spells                      |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| 3rd           | charm person, false life             |
| 5th           | invisibility, suggestion             |
| 9th           | gaseous form, vampiric touch         |
| 13th          | charm monster*, greater invisibility |
| 17th          | dominate person, passwall            |

**Shattered Oath (3rd).** Subtract your Paladin level from ability checks to convince a creature to trust you or enter any deal or agreement; creatures distrust you.

**Selfish Smite (3rd, Oath Smite, necrotic).** Gain temporary hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

**Illusory Escape (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** When a source you can see damages you, use a reaction and spend 4 Resolve to become invisible and move up to your speed. Invisibility lasts until your next turn starts or you attack or force a save.

**Aura of Deception (7th).** When using Illusory Escape, force a creature in your aura to make a Charisma save. On failure, you and it switch places; it takes the triggering damage, and you gain Illusory Escape's normal benefits from your new space. On success, you gain the normal benefits.

**Forceful Will (15th).** A creature in your aura has disadvantage on its initial save against an enchantment spell you force it to make.

**Avatar of Dishonor (20th).** Become invisible as by greater invisibility; take Dash or Hide as a bonus action; when a creature misses you with a melee attack, make it repeat the attack against another creature you choose within its normal range.

---

frontmatter.title: Oath of Prosperity
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of Prosperity

Prosperity paladins pursue material wealth, measuring actions and lives by their value in gold. **Tenets:** Benefit—analyze gains before acting; Investment—make every action pay; Profit—never enter a bad deal.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                        |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| 3rd           | alarm, identify                    |
| 5th           | arcane lock, locate object         |
| 9th           | glyph of warding, tiny servant XGE |
| 13th          | fabricate, secret chest            |
| 17th          | animate objects, legend lore       |

**Distilled Fortune (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As an action, touch a Large or smaller nonmagical object not worn or carried with your holy symbol, transforming it into a Tiny gemstone worth the same amount. As an action, touch the gem with your holy symbol to restore the original object.

**Vault of Prosperity (3rd, Channel Divinity, 2 Resolve).** When casting a Paladin spell with a material component with stated gold cost, spend 2 Resolve to reduce the total cost by 50 gp per Paladin level.

**Aura of Prosperity (7th).** Once per turn per creature, when a creature you choose in your aura is targeted by a spell restoring hit points or granting temporary hit points, or by Lay on Hands, add Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to the amount granted.

**Fortunate Defense (15th).** When damaged by a creature you see, use a reaction to destroy a Distilled Fortune gemstone and reduce the damage by 1d10 per 100 gp of its value.

**Golden Guardian (20th).** As a bonus action, transform for 1 minute: gain temporary hit points equal to twice your level; as a bonus action grant a creature within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier; while you or another creature has these temporary hit points, you have a golden sheen and resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of Repentance
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of Repentance

You seek forgiveness and use violence only as a last resort. **Tenets:** Peace—violence is a last resort; Poverty—give excess wealth to those suffering; Redemption—no mortal is beyond forgiveness.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                          |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| 3rd           | sanctuary, sleep                     |
| 5th           | calm emotions, hold person           |
| 9th           | counterspell ll, hypnotic pattern ll |
| 13th          | aura of life, resilient sphere       |
| 17th          | hold monster, wall of force ll       |

**Righteous Emissary (3rd, Channel Divinity, 2 Resolve).** When you make a Persuasion check, spend 2 Resolve to add your Paladin level.

**Subduing Smite (3rd, Channel Divinity, 2 Resolve).** When a smite reduces a creature to 0 hit points, spend 2 Resolve to leave it at 1 hit point instead and charm it for 1 minute. It is docile and takes no movement or actions unless you use a bonus action to order it; you can't order it to attack or force checks or saves. Ends if you are incapacitated, use it again, or you or allies act hostile toward it.

**Aura of Penance (7th).** When a creature under your aura takes damage, use a reaction to take half that damage (rounded up) instead. It can't be reduced, and non-damage effects don't transfer.

**Redemptive Regeneration (15th).** If you start your turn below half your hit points but with at least 1, regain hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.

**Avatar of Redemption (20th).** Gain resistance to all damage and use Aura of Penance without a reaction. If you damage a creature or force it to save, these benefits are lost until the start of your next turn.

---

entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of the Shield
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of the Shield

Divine Shields defend the innocent by standing between allies and danger. **Tenets:** Defend—protect those who seek aid; Immovable—keep your vows; Resilient—stand firm while innocents are at risk.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                      |
| ------------- | -------------------------------- |
| 3rd           | shield, shield of faith          |
| 5th           | aid, warding bond                |
| 9th           | protection from energy, tiny hut |
| 13th          | fire shield, resilient sphere    |
| 17th          | circle of power, wall of stone   |

**Shimmering Ward (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As an action, project a 10-foot-radius shimmering aura that lasts until you move. Creatures you choose in it gain half cover.

**Holy Abjuration (3rd, Channel Divinity, 2 Resolve).** When a spell or magical effect damages you, use a reaction to reduce it by Charisma modifier (minimum 1) + Paladin level. If reduced to 0, dispel the entire spell or effect.

**Aura of Defense (7th).** When another creature in your aura is hit, use a reaction to add Charisma modifier to its AC against the attack.

**Adamant Stance (15th).** A creature trying to move you against your will must succeed on a Strength check, DC 10 + Paladin level + Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

**Divine Bulwark (20th).** As a bonus action, empower your aura for 1 minute: at the start of your turn distribute 20 temporary hit points among living creatures in it; creatures you choose gain three-quarters cover; whenever a creature in the aura takes damage, you can take it instead.

entries.title: Oath of Splendor
entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of Splendor
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of Splendor

You serve a primordial power and remake the material plane in its elemental image. **Tenets:** Destruction—display elemental power; Nobility—act with beauty befitting your patron; Wrath—destroy those who oppose or disrespect you.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

**Primordial Sovereign (3rd).** Choose your element; only a wish can change it. Use Charisma instead of Dexterity to calculate AC.

| Element | Damage type |
| ------- | ----------- |
| Air     | thunder     |
| Earth   | bludgeoning |
| Fire    | fire        |
| Water   | cold        |

| Paladin level | Oath spells                                                |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| 3rd           | absorb elements*, burning hands                            |
| 5th           | mirror image, scorching ray                                |
| 9th           | elemental bane ll, summon elemental ll (your element only) |
| 13th          | wall of fire, ice storm                                    |
| 17th          | contact other plane, flame strike                          |

Whenever you cast a Splendor spell, its damage uses your element's type instead of its normal type.

**Elemental Smite (3rd, Oath Smite, your element's damage).** Air: Strength save or push 10 feet and no reactions until its next turn starts. Earth: Strength save or prone. Fire: target ignites and takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of its next turn. Water: Strength save or encased in ice, speed halved until its next turn ends.

**Aura of Destruction (7th).** When a creature in your aura takes your element's damage, you can make that instance ignore resistance and treat immunity as resistance.

**Elemental Rebuke (15th).** When a creature in your aura damages you, use a reaction to force a Dexterity save; on failure, it takes 2d8 damage of your element's type and suffers your Elemental Smite rider.

**Avatar of the Elements (20th).** Gain elemental wings (flying speed 60 feet); creatures you choose in your aura gain resistance to your element's damage and you gain immunity to it; your element's damage to structures is maximized.

---

entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of the Templar
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of the Templar

Templars are temple-trained knights who withstand foes, aid allies, and comfort the faithful. Their temple may provide quests, tokens, and shelter. **Tenets:** Faith—let faith be your shield; Loyalty—let temple and allies be your weapons; Unwavering—do not fear the divine.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                   |
| ------------- | ----------------------------- |
| 3rd           | bless, guiding bolt           |
| 5th           | silence, zone of truth        |
| 9th           | daylight, spirit guardians    |
| 13th          | divination, guardian of faith |
| 17th          | commune, hallow               |

**Hand of Temple (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As an action, shed bright light in a 30-foot radius. Up to five allies of your choice in the area regain 1 hit point at the end of each of their turns for 1 minute.

**Will of Temple (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As an action, shed bright light in a 30-foot radius. Each ally in the area can repeat a save of its choice within 1 minute, before the DM declares the first roll's result.

**Aura of Temple (7th).** You and creatures you choose in your Aura of Protection reduce damage from spell and weapon attacks by 2. At 18th level, reduction becomes 4.

**Temple's Favorite Soul (15th).** Always under heroism; it grants 7 temporary hit points at the start of each turn. This amount doesn't change.

**High Templar (20th).** Shed bright light in 10 feet and dim light 10 feet farther; opaque covering blocks it. As an action, once per long rest, emanate a mobile 30-foot-radius divine aura for 1 minute; enemies inside take -4 to ability checks, attacks, and saves.

---

entries.title: Oath of the Throne
entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of the Throne
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of the Throne

You serve your sovereign, uphold their laws, and protect their lands and subjects. **Tenets:** Bravery—carry out orders despite overwhelming odds; Loyalty—serve your liege's interests; Order—uphold the law as civilization's bedrock.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                        |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| 3rd           | command, compelled duel ll         |
| 5th           | find steed ll, warding bond        |
| 9th           | aura of vitality, spirit guardians |
| 13th          | banishment, guardian of faith      |
| 17th          | circle of power, geas              |

**Challenging Smite (3rd, Oath Smite, radiant).** Wisdom save or disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you until the end of its next turn.

**Rallying Command (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As a bonus action, a creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand you gains temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier.

**Oathbound Guard (7th).** When a creature in your aura takes damage, use your reaction to take that damage instead. It can't be reduced, and non-damage effects don't transfer.

**Unwavering Knight (15th).** While conscious, you have advantage on saves to resist paralyzed and stunned.

**Avatar of Loyalty (20th).** Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Creatures under your aura have advantage on Wisdom saves and death saves. A creature that fails its save against Challenging Smite also can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you until its next turn ends.

---

entries.title: Oath of Vengeance
entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of Vengeance
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of Vengeance

Avengers dedicate their lives to destroying a sworn foe or corrupt organization. **Tenets:** Destroy Evil—fight sworn foes and the greater evil; No Mercy—defeat evil by any means; Restitution—make amends for your foes' evil and other evildoers.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                |
| ------------- | -------------------------- |
| 3rd           | bane, compelled duel ll    |
| 5th           | hold person, misty step    |
| 9th           | haste, nondetection        |
| 13th          | banishment, dimension door |
| 17th          | far step*, hold monster    |

**Vow of Enmity (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As a bonus action, mark a creature you see within 30 feet as your Sworn Foe for 1 minute or until it dies. You have advantage on all attacks against it. You can't use this again while your Sworn Foe lives.

**Vengeful Smite (3rd, Oath Smite, fire).** Wisdom save or the target's speed is halved until its next turn ends. Your Sworn Foe has disadvantage on the save.

**Shield of Vengeance (7th).** Creatures under your aura have advantage on ability checks and saves your Sworn Foe forces them to make.

**Relentless Avenger (15th).** When your Sworn Foe attacks or forces another creature to save, use a reaction to move up to your speed toward it and make one attack. If hit by an opportunity attack during this reaction, add Charisma modifier to your attack roll.

**Avatar of Vengeance (20th).** Use Vow of Enmity without Resolve; cast misty step each turn at will without a slot and, if reappearing within 5 feet of a creature, make a melee weapon attack against it; once per turn when making a weapon attack with advantage, forgo that advantage to make one additional attack against that creature.

---

[[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index|All Paladin Oaths]] · [[character-options/classes/Paladin|Paladin class]]

entries.title: Oath of Vigilance
entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of Vigilance
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of Vigilance

You protect the material plane from extraplanar influence, whatever its nature. **Tenets:** Discipline—hone body and mind; Purity—don't bargain with or fall under extraplanar influence; Vigilance—find and root it out.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                   |
| ------------- | ----------------------------- |
| 3rd           | alarm, ethereal anchor ll     |
| 5th           | locate creature ll, moonbeam  |
| 9th           | counterspell ll, nondetection |
| 13th          | aura of purity, banishment    |
| 17th          | hold monster, scrying         |

Unless your DM or table decides otherwise, aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, and fiends are extraplanar, as are many creatures not native to the material plane.

**Abjuring Smite (3rd, Oath Smite, force).** Charisma save or push the target 10 feet away. Extraplanar creatures have disadvantage.

**Divine Vigilance (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** When you or a creature within 10 feet fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, use your reaction and spend 4 Resolve to let it repeat the save. At 6th level, this can help any creature under your Aura of Protection.

**Aura of Vigilance (7th).** Creatures under your aura can't be surprised and add your Charisma modifier to initiative.

**Vigilant Sight (15th).** Divine Sense also grants truesight within the same radius.

**Avatar of Vigilance (20th).** Divine Sense reaches 120 feet; your attacks against extraplanar creatures within truesight range have advantage; a creature that fails against Abjuring Smite is pushed 30 feet and has speed halved until its next turn ends.

---

[[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index|All Paladin Oaths]] · [[character-options/classes/Paladin|Paladin class]]

entries.title: Oath of the Wilds
entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of the Wilds
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of the Wilds

Wilds paladins protect the balance between civilization and nature and embody the power of beasts. **Tenets:** Balance—keep nature and civilization in balance; Freedom—let living things choose their path; Natural Law—uphold the world's natural order.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                  |
| ------------- | ---------------------------- |
| 3rd           | command, speak with animals  |
| 5th           | beast sense, find steed      |
| 9th           | conjure animals, fear        |
| 13th          | dominate beast, giant insect |
| 17th          | awaken, insect plague        |

**Predator's Mark (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As a bonus action, mark a creature you see within 120 feet as your Prey for 1 hour. Add Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to checks to track, tame, grapple, or subdue it.

**Soothe Beast (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As an action, touch a beast with your holy symbol. Wisdom save or charmed for 1 hour, ending if you or allies harm it.

**Aura of Savagery (7th).** Creatures you choose in your aura score a melee weapon critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

**Undying Predator (15th).** When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point (once per long rest). You suffer no drawbacks of old age and can't be aged magically.

**Primal Champion (20th).** As a bonus action, transform for 1 minute, ending if incapacitated: creatures in your Aura of Savagery score melee critical hits on 18–20; gain 10 temporary hit points at the start of each turn; as a bonus action each turn, move up to your speed toward a hostile creature you see and, if ending within 5 feet, make a melee weapon attack with advantage.

---

entries.title: Oath of the Zealot
entries.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

frontmatter.title: Oath of the Zealot
frontmatter.summary: Revised Sacred Oath for the Paladin

entries.body:
# Oath of the Zealot

Zealots are master orators and warriors whose strict faith makes heretics and infidels their mortal enemies. **Tenets:** Divine Might—prepare to fight your deity's enemies; God's Kingdom—rule with wisdom and strength; True Path—those who defy it are infidels.

See the shared [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#oath-smites|Oath Smite rules]] and [[character-options/subclasses/Paladin/index#avatar-terms|Avatar terms]].

| Paladin level | Oath spells                          |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| 3rd           | bane, detect magic                   |
| 5th           | flame blade, pass without trace      |
| 9th           | bestow curse, protection from energy |
| 13th          | confusion, freedom of movement       |
| 17th          | hallow, planar binding               |

**Dedicated Faithful (3rd).** When you would expend a spell slot to cast a spell or use a smite, you can spend 4 Resolve per slot level instead.

**Call of the Zealot (3rd, Channel Divinity, 4 Resolve).** As an action, choose creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) that can hear you within 30 feet. Choose charmed, frightened, bless, or bane for each. Charm and fear last until the end of your next turn; bless and bane last 1 minute without concentration. Unwilling targets can make a Charisma save. At 10th level, double range and target count.

**Eyes of the Faithful (7th).** When you or a friendly creature within 10 feet hits with a weapon attack, the target sheds bright light in 10 feet, is visible and can't benefit from invisibility, automatically fails Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and the next melee weapon attack against it has advantage, all until its next turn ends. Choose light color; you and allies may opt out.

**Will of the Zealot (15th).** Advantage on saves against enchantment and illusion spells.

**Shadow of the Divine (20th).** Reroll an ability check, attack roll, damage roll, or save after rolling and after the DM declares the result; choose which result to use. Uses per long rest equal Charisma modifier (minimum 2). A creature with truesight sees an immense ethereal hand of your deity reaching from the sky to protect and guide you.

entries.title: Order of Reason
entries.summary: Divine Order: Scholarship and knowledge of enemies

frontmatter.title: Order of Reason
frontmatter.summary: Divine Order: Scholarship and knowledge of enemies

entries.body:
Realms are filled with the enemies of holy temples, originating from different aspects of evil. They are armed in numerous ways, adapted to various uninhabitable places owing to their supernatural fortitude, and are taught how to desecrate the efforts of the good. It is the duty of the members of the Order of Reason to study such creatures and to strategize against them. They are the keepers of the temples' bestiaries and incredibly efficient leaders against the forces of evil.

When you become a member of the Order of Reason, you become proficient in one of the following skills of your choice: Arcana, History, Nature, Religion. Also, you learn a cantrip or gain a weapon proficiency of your choice.

## Avatar features

Members of the Order of Reason can choose these avatar features, as well as the general avatar features on the Paragon page.

![[class-options-of.base]]

entries.title: Order of the Voice
entries.summary: Divine Order: Voice, diplomacy, and sacred song

frontmatter.title: Order of the Voice
frontmatter.summary: Divine Order: Voice, diplomacy, and sacred song

entries.body:
To hear someone speaking Sacred Language echoing through the hallowed halls of a cathedral is a joyous experience in and of itself, but to be able to speak the language of the divine is an absolutely euphoric one. The members of the Order of the Voice pursue perfect control over their voices and spend most of their time singing with temple choruses and reading sacred texts. They are the diplomats of many temples, their emissaries, their mediators, and the voices of their ultimatums.

When you become a member of the Order of the Voice, you learn the [[Message]] cantrip and another bard cantrip of your choice. When you reach 5th level in this class, you can cast [[Sending]] once with this feature, requiring no spell components, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

## Avatar features

Members of the Order of the Voice can choose these avatar features, as well as the general avatar features on the Paragon page.

entries.title: Order of Valor
entries.summary: Divine Order: Close combat and martial prowess

frontmatter.title: Order of Valor
frontmatter.summary: Divine Order: Close combat and martial prowess

entries.body:
The blade of sacred temples discriminates against no act of evil. It must be swift and strong against any foul doing regardless of it being done by a friend or a foe. Although it is intended as such in theory, such dedication is hard to achieve in practice, which is why the Order of Valor exists.

When a member of the clergy goes rogue, a paragon armed for this duty, who is educated in the ways of the temple, intercepts the corrupted in the name of the temple and of the deity it stands for.

When you become a member of the Order of Valor, you become proficient with a martial weapon of your choice.

## Avatar features

Members of the Order of Valor can choose these avatar features, as well as the general avatar features on the Paragon page.

entries.title: Evil Slayer
entries.summary: Ranger Conclave for the Ranger

frontmatter.title: Evil Slayer
frontmatter.summary: Ranger Conclave for the Ranger

entries.body:
You are a zealous hunter of evil masters and their minions. An Evil Slayer searches for all kinds of evil and excels at both drawing them out and slaying them. Evil slayers are destined to become the heroes of glorious legends, even if some of them are crushed beneath the feet of evil and are forgotten in the dusty pages of history.

## Features

> [!info]- Sense Evil (level 3)
> Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you become more sensitive to the presence of evil near you.
>
> You can use your action to sense if there is any evil-aligned creature within 60 feet of you. However, you cannot sense its exact distance, direction, or the number of companions it may have with it.
>
> Starting at 11th level, you can use this feature to pinpoint evil creatures within 60 feet of you.
>
> Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest to use it again.

> [!info]- Slay Evil (level 3)
> Starting at 3rd level, you can benefit from the slightest of opportunities to strike your enemies. When an evil creature within your reach misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack as an opportunity attack.

> [!info]- Know Thy Enemy (level 3)
> Also starting at 3rd level, you are able to categorize the enemies you encounter and jot down their strengths and weaknesses. In time, you gain the ability to do research about your potential enemies, learning about their methods and preparing accordingly in advance (by crafting special mixtures, buying specific spell scrolls etc.).
>
> Each time you gain a level in this class, you add an enemy to your list, called the List of Righteous Hunt. These enemies should be specific such as the cultists of a demon lord, the minions of a lich, or the thralls of an ancient evil. To elaborate, the undead or fiends cannot be declared enemies as they are too general as categories. However, the enemies you choose with the Favored Enemy feature are also on this list.
>
> When you hit a creature on the list with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 1d8 damage.
>
> You and others can use your List of Righteous Hunt as a sourcebook in hunting down enemies, which grants advantage on Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, Religion) checks.

> [!info]- Escaping the Evil (level 7)
> Starting at 7th level, evil creatures have disadvantage on opportunity attack rolls made against you. If the creature is on your List of Righteous Hunt, it cannot make an opportunity attack against you.

> [!info]- No Mercy to Evil (level 11)
> Starting at 11th level, you do not let evil escape. On each of your turns, you can make your first opportunity attack, requiring no action of any kind.
>
> In addition, you have advantage on weapon attack rolls against the enemies on your List of Righteous Hunt.

> [!info]- Out of Evil's Reach (level 15)
> Starting at 15th level, you can magically protect yourself against the attacks of evil. When you take damage from an attack or an effect by an evil source, you can halve the damage as a reaction.
>
> Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest to use it again.

_From Corpus Angelus._

entries.title: Holy Messenger
entries.summary: Ranger Conclave for the Ranger

frontmatter.title: Holy Messenger
frontmatter.summary: Ranger Conclave for the Ranger

entries.body:
Holy Messengers are the chosen couriers of divine forces. They carry their divine words to mortals and sometimes to other deities. Holy messengers are known for their speed and their iconic, shining armor. Usually, they receive word of their divine purpose in their dreams or visions, and start spreading the divine word as fast as they can. People in some places believe that a visit by a holy messenger brings good harvest, but this is simply not true.

## Features

> [!info]- Holy Messenger Magic (level 3)
> Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Holy Messenger Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

## Holy Messenger spells

| Ranger level | Spells                |
| ------------ | --------------------- |
| 3rd          | [[Radiant Wayfinder]] |
| 5th          | [[Prayer of Healing]] |
| 9th          | [[Beacon of Hope]]    |
| 13th         | [[Guardian of Faith]] |
| 17th         | [[Blood of a Saint]]  |

> [!info]- Armor of the Messenger (level 3)
> At 3rd level, divine forces bless you with a spectral-looking, shining armor to help you in your journeys. As an action, you can summon the Armor of the Messenger onto yourself or dismiss it. You can also summon this armor on top of another armor since the Armor of the Messenger doesn't provide AC. The armor sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet. You can work with your GM to determine the appearance of your armor. When you summon the Armor of the Messenger, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice;
>
> **Celerity of the Unicorn.** The armor's leg pieces flash a bright light, and your speed increases by 20 feet for 1 hour.
>
> **Flight of the Pegasus.** The armor's back piece flashes with light, and translucent pegasus wings sprout from it. You gain a flying speed of 30 feet for 1 hour.
>
> **Rush of the Shark.** An armor made of fin-like translucent pieces extends around you, granting you a swimming speed of 30 feet for 1 hour.
>
> Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest. When you reach 10th level in this class, you can use this feature twice.

> [!info]- Messenger's Fury (level 7)
> At 7th level, your attacks clear the way against heretics. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can choose to deal radiant damage instead of the damage normally dealt by the attack. If you choose to use this feature against your favored enemy, the target takes an extra 1d6 radiant damage.
>
> You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain any expended uses when you finish a long rest.

> [!info]- Unknown Gospel (level 11)
> At 11th level, as you carry the will and the words of the divine, you memorize some of them. As an action, you can shout out a single word granted to you by your deity that isn't in any known language. When you do so, each evil-aligned creature that can hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 3d6 psychic damage and is frightened of you for 1 minute. On a successful save, the damage is halved and the creature isn't frightened.
>
> Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

> [!info]- The Sacred Envoy (level 15)
> At 15th level, your abilities as a messenger are heard across the heavens and the divine reward your prowess accordingly:
>
> - Armor of the Messenger sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.
>
> - You can use the feature of Armor of the Messenger for an unlimited amount of time and you can gain all the benefits of it instead of one if you choose to do so.
>
> - Your movement doesn't provoke any opportunity attacks.
>
> - Once per week, you can cast the plane shift and teleport spells, requiring no material components.

_From Corpus Angelus._

entries.title: Hunter
entries.summary: Ranger Archetype for the Ranger

frontmatter.title: Hunter
frontmatter.summary: Ranger Archetype for the Ranger

entries.body:
_Ranger Archetype (Ranger subclass)_

Emulating the Hunter archetype means accepting your place as a bulwark between civilization and the terrors of the wilderness. As you walk the Hunter's path, you learn specialized techniques for fighting the threats you face, from rampaging ogres and hordes of orcs to towering giants and terrifying dragons.

## Features

> [!info]- Hunter's Prey (level 3)
> At 3rd level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.
>
> Colossus Slayer
>
> Giant Killer
>
> Horde Breaker

> [!info]- Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer (level 3)
> Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage if it's below its hit point maximum. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

> [!info]- Hunter's Prey: Giant Killer (level 3)
> When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to attack that creature immediately after its attack, provided that you can see the creature.

> [!info]- Hunter's Prey: Horde Breaker (level 3)
> Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within range of your weapon.

> [!info]- Defensive Tactics (level 7)
> At 7th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.
>
> Escape the Horde
>
> Multiattack Defense
>
> Steel Will

> [!info]- Defensive Tactics: Escape the Horde (level 7)
> Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

> [!info]- Defensive Tactics: Multiattack Defense (level 7)
> When a creature hits you with an attack, you gain a +4 bonus to AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.

> [!info]- Defensive Tactics: Steel Will (level 7)
> You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

> [!info]- Multiattack (level 11)
> At 11th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.
>
> Volley
>
> Whirlwind Attack

> [!info]- Multiattack: Volley (level 11)
> You can use your action to make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon's range. You must have ammunition for each target, as normal, and you make a separate attack roll for each target.

> [!info]- Multiattack: Whirlwind Attack (level 11)
> You can use your action to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate attack roll for each target.

> [!info]- Superior Hunter's Defense (level 15)
> At 15th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.
>
> Evasion
>
> Stand Against the Tide
>
> Uncanny Dodge

> [!info]- Superior Hunter's Defense: Evasion (level 15)
> When you are subjected to an effect, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or a lightning bolt spell, that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

> [!info]- Superior Hunter's Defense: Stand Against the Tide (level 15)
> When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to repeat the same attack against another creature (other than itself) of your choice.

> [!info]- Superior Hunter's Defense: Uncanny Dodge (level 15)
> When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.
